guide.summary: 过 right after a verb says the action has happened at least once before now: it is life experience, not the story of one event. 我去过北京 = 'I have been to Beijing (so I know it)'. The experience is over and done, the negative is 没…过 (过 stays), and 了 is what you use to report a particular event. A second use, V过了, simply means a routine thing is already done.

subs.label: V过: have done it before
subs.focus: Choose 过 (not 了, 着, 的 or nothing) for 'have ever / have done before'; the experience is over (他当过老师: not one now). Mistake: bare verb or 了 for 'have been to / have tried'. Give 'so I know it' context (以前, 小时候, a follow-up comment) so 了 cannot fit.

subs.label: Where 过 goes
subs.focus: Put 过 right after the verb, before the object, and inside verb-object words (见过面, 结过婚, 游过泳, 洗过澡); after 去/来 + place it goes on the action verb (去那儿吃过饭). Mistakes: 看那个电影过, 见面过, 过 before the verb. Best as order items or cloze with competing positions.

subs.label: 没…过: have never / have not
subs.focus: Negate with 没 or 没有 and keep 过, no 了; include 还没…过 for 'not yet'. Mistakes: 不去过, dropping 过 (which turns 'have never been' into 'did not go'), adding 了. Make the English cue clearly 'have never / have not ever' so plain 没 + verb is not also right.

subs.label: 过 or 了
subs.focus: Decide: experience, over now (过) or a specific event / result that still holds (了: 他去了上海, he is away). Mistake: 过 for a narrated event, 了 for 'have ever'. Bare sentences often take both, so force one: 现在不在家 / 下星期回来 / a chain of events for 了; 'I know it', 以前, 'ever' for 过.

subs.label: 过 with 次 and 遍
subs.focus: Build Verb + 过 + number + 次/遍; ordinary object after the count or fronted, pronoun before it (见过他两次), place name either side (give both in alts). 次 = occasions, 遍 = whole run-through (read, watch, listen, say, write). Mistakes: 去三次过, 见过两次他, count before the verb.

subs.label: V过了: already done
subs.focus: Recognise V过了 as 'already done' for routine actions (meals, medicine, washing, checking, asking); the object goes between 过 and 了 or is fronted; negative is 还没 + verb (呢). Mistakes: reading 吃过了 as life experience, 还没吃过了. Use offers, reminders, 'have you ... yet?' exchanges.

subs.label: Asking: 过吗 / 过没有 / 有没有…过
subs.focus: The learner must form 'have you ever' questions three ways (V过…吗, V过…没有, 有没有 V过…) and answer by repeating the verb (去过 / 没去过), and ask 几次 for 'how many times'. Classic mistakes: A-not-A made with 不 (去不去过, 去过不去过), answering 是 / 不是. 有没有…吗 is said colloquially: never judge-wrong.

subs.label: 从来没…过: never ever
subs.focus: Build 从来 + 没(有) + verb + 过 for 'have never once' and separate it from 从来不 + verb (habit, no 过). Mistakes: 从来不喝过, 从来没喝了, dropping 过, 从来 placed after 没. Include 从来没见过这么 + adjective + 的 + noun ('never seen such a ...').

rules.rule: To say something has happened at least once before now, put 过 right after the verb. Do not add 了.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo běi jīng
examples.en: I have been to Beijing.

examples.py: tā xué guo hàn yǔ
examples.en: She has studied Chinese before.

examples.py: wǒ chī guo zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ
examples.en: I have had this kind of fruit before.

rules.note: English often uses a plain past here ('I studied Chinese once'). If the point is 'this is part of my experience', Chinese wants 过.

rules.rule: 过 means the action is over and no longer going on. It can be long ago or a minute ago, and a time word is allowed.

examples.py: tā dāng guo lǎo shī
examples.en: He used to be a teacher.

examples.py: wǒ zài shàng hǎi zhù guo liǎng nián
examples.en: I lived in Shanghai for two years.

examples.py: xiǎo wáng gāng cái lái guo
examples.en: Xiao Wang came by just now.

rules.note: 小王刚才来过 tells you he has left again. 我在上海住过两年 tells you I no longer live there.

rules.rule: 过 sticks to the verb. The object comes after 过, and in verb-object words 过 goes in the middle.

examples.py: wǒ kàn guo nà ge diàn yǐng
examples.en: I have seen that film.

examples.py: wǒ men jiàn guo miàn
examples.en: We have met before.

examples.py: wǒ zài hǎi lǐ yóu guo yǒng
examples.en: I have swum in the sea.

rules.note: Common verb-object words: 见面, 结婚, 游泳, 睡觉, 洗澡, 跳舞, 唱歌. When 去 or 来 plus a place comes before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb: 我去那儿吃过饭.

rules.rule: The negative is 没 or 没有 before the verb, and 过 stays. Never 不, never 了.
rules.pattern: Subject + 没(有) + Verb + 过 + Object

examples.py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi
examples.en: I have never been to Shanghai.

examples.py: tā méi yǒu chī guo jiǎo zi
examples.en: He has never eaten dumplings.

examples.py: wǒ hái méi qù guo cháng chéng
examples.en: I haven't been to the Great Wall yet.

rules.note: This is the opposite of 了, which disappears after 没. Without 过 the meaning changes: 我没去上海 is 'I didn't go to Shanghai' (that time).

rules.rule: 过 = it has happened at some point and is over. 了 = this event took place, and its result may still hold now.
rules.pattern: Verb + 过 (experience)  /  Verb + 了 (this event)

examples.py: tā qù guo shàng hǎi
examples.en: He has been to Shanghai.

examples.py: tā qù le shàng hǎi
examples.en: He has gone to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 我学过游泳，可是没学会。
examples.py: wǒ xué guo yóu yǒng kě shì méi xué huì
examples.en: I took swimming lessons once, but I never learned to swim.

rules.note: 他去过上海 means he went and came back. 他去了上海 is normally understood as 'he went, and is there now or on his way'.

rules.rule: Telling what happened on one occasion takes 了. Mentioning that you already know something from before takes 过.
rules.pattern: (specific time) + Verb + 了 + number + measure + Object

examples.zh: 昨天晚上我们看了一个电影。
examples.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men kàn le yī ge diàn yǐng
examples.en: We watched a film last night.

examples.zh: 这个电影我看过，很有意思。
examples.py: zhè ge diàn yǐng wǒ kàn guo hěn yǒu yì si
examples.en: I've seen this film; it's really good.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le liǎng jiàn yī fu
examples.en: I bought two pieces of clothing yesterday.

rules.note: A past time word does not decide the choice by itself: 我去年去过一次 is fine. Ask whether the speaker is narrating an event (了) or citing experience (过).

rules.rule: To say how many times, put the number + 次 after 过. An ordinary object follows the count or moves to the front; a pronoun goes before the count.
rules.pattern: Verb + 过 + number + 次 + Object  /  Verb + 过 + pronoun + number + 次

examples.py: wǒ chī guo yī cì běi jīng kǎo yā
examples.en: I have had Beijing roast duck once.

examples.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
examples.en: I have met him twice.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng
examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.

examples.py: nǐ qù guo jǐ cì
examples.en: How many times have you been?

rules.note: With a place name both orders are used: 我去过两次北京 and 我去过北京两次. Say 两次, not 二次.

rules.rule: Use 遍 instead of 次 when you mean the whole thing from beginning to end: reading, watching, listening, saying, writing.
rules.pattern: Object + Subject + Verb + 过 + number + 遍

examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo sān biàn
examples.en: I have read this book three times.

examples.zh: 这个故事我听过很多遍。
examples.py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn
examples.en: I have heard this story many times.

rules.note: 次 only counts occasions and is never wrong for going, meeting or eating. For books and films 次 is also heard, but 遍 is the natural choice when you went through all of it.

rules.rule: Verb + 过 + 了 says a routine or expected thing is already done. It is not about life experience.
rules.pattern: Subject + (已经) + Verb + 过 + (Object) + 了

examples.py: wǒ chī guo le xiè xie
examples.en: I've already eaten, thanks.

examples.py: yào wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le
examples.en: I've already taken my medicine.

examples.py: nǐ xǐ guo zǎo le ma
examples.en: Have you had your shower yet?

rules.note: The negative answer drops both: 还没吃呢 or 还没有, not 还没吃过了. Compare 我吃过饭了 (I've eaten, today) with 我吃过日本菜 (I have tried Japanese food, ever).

rules.rule: Ask 'have you ever' with 吗 at the end, with 没有 at the end, or with 有没有 before the verb. Pick one; do not combine them.
rules.pattern: Verb + 过 + Object + 吗  /  Verb + 过 + Object + 没有  /  有没有 + Verb + 过 + Object

examples.py: nǐ qù guo zhōng guó ma
examples.en: Have you ever been to China?

examples.py: nǐ chī guo jiǎo zi méi yǒu
examples.en: Have you ever eaten dumplings?

examples.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn guo zhè běn shū
examples.en: Have you read this book?

rules.note: You will also hear Verb + 没 + Verb + 过 (你去没去过中国？) and, casually, 有没有…吗. The A-not-A form is never made with 不.

rules.rule: Answer by repeating the verb with 过: Verb + 过 for yes, 没 + Verb + 过 for no.
rules.pattern: Verb + 过  /  没 + Verb + 过

examples.py: qù guo qù guo liǎng cì
examples.en: Yes, twice.

examples.py: méi qù guo
examples.en: No, I haven't.

examples.py: hái méi yǒu wǒ hěn xiǎng qù
examples.en: Not yet, but I'd love to go.

rules.rule: 'Have never once' is 从来 + 没(有) + Verb + 过. Keep 过. 从来不 + Verb, without 过, is a habit: 'never do'.
rules.pattern: Subject + 从来 + 没(有) + Verb + 过 + Object

examples.py: wǒ cóng lái méi hē guo jiǔ
examples.en: I have never drunk alcohol.

examples.py: tā cóng lái méi chí dào guo
examples.en: He has never been late.

examples.zh: 我从来没见过这么大的雪。
examples.py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me dà de xuě
examples.en: I have never seen such heavy snow.

examples.py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē jiǔ
examples.en: I never drink alcohol.

rules.note: 从来没喝过 is about your whole past up to now; 从来不喝 is your rule or habit. 从来 always comes before 没 or 不.

right.py: wǒ méi qù guo běi jīng
right.en: I have never been to Beijing.

contrasts.why: 过 is about what has or has not happened, so the negative is always 没 or 没有. 不 cannot be used with 过.

right.py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi
right.en: I have never been to Shanghai.

contrasts.why: English 'have' tempts you to add 了, but experience is 过 alone, and 没 never goes with this 了.

right.py: wǒ kàn guo nà ge diàn yǐng

contrasts.why: 过 attaches to the verb, not to the end of the sentence. The object comes after it.

right.py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn

contrasts.why: 见面 is verb + object (见 + 面), so the standard place for 过 is after 见 (见面过 is heard casually). The same holds for 结过婚, 游过泳, 洗过澡.

contrasts.wrong: 他去过上海，下星期回来。

right.zh: 他去了上海，下星期回来。
right.py: tā qù le shàng hǎi xià xīng qī huí lái
right.en: He has gone to Shanghai and will be back next week.

contrasts.why: 过 means the trip is over and he is back. He is still away, so this is a completed event whose result still holds: 了.

right.py: wǒ qù guo sān cì běi jīng
right.en: I have been to Beijing three times.

contrasts.why: 过 comes straight after the verb; the number of times follows 过. 我去过北京三次 is also correct.

right.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì

contrasts.why: A pronoun object goes before the count. Only ordinary nouns and place names can follow 两次.

right.py: nǐ qù guo cháng chéng méi yǒu
right.en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?

contrasts.why: Because the negative of 过 is 没, the question uses 没有 (or 吗, or 有没有 before the verb), never 不.

right.py: wǒ cóng lái méi hē guo jiǔ

contrasts.why: With 过 the negative must be 没. 从来不 exists, but only without 过, for a habit: 我从来不喝酒.
吃过了 means 'already eaten'. Its negative is plain 还没 + verb; 了 cannot follow 没, and 过 is not needed.

cheat: 'Have ever / have before / used to' with no single occasion being told: verb + 过, and no 了.
过 is glued to the verb: 看过电影, 见过面, 结过婚. Never at the end after the object.
Negative: 没 + verb + 过. Keep 过, never 不, never 了.
Still away, still true, or telling what happened that day: 了. Been and back, or 'I know it from before': 过.
How many times: verb + 过 + 两次 + object, but pronoun first (见过他两次). Whole book or film: 遍.
吃过了 = already done today. Negative: 还没吃呢.
Questions: …过吗 / …过没有 / 有没有…过, one of them only. 从来 goes with 没…过; 从来不 takes no 过.

items.q: 我以前在这家公司工作___。
items.zh: 我以前在这家公司工作过。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò guo
items.en: I used to work at this company.
items.why: 以前 plus a bare verb that ends the sentence is a life experience: 过. 了 would leave the sentence hanging, and 着 would mean you still work there.

items.q: 小王以前当___护士。
items.zh: 小王以前当过护士。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yǐ qián dāng guo hù shi
items.en: Xiao Wang used to be a nurse.
items.why: 以前 marks a past stretch that is over, so 过. 当了护士 would need a result or a following clause, and 着 means a state still going on.

items.q: 我小时候曾经学___游泳。
items.zh: 我小时候曾经学过游泳。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou céng jīng xué guo yóu yǒng
items.en: I took swimming lessons when I was a child.
items.why: 曾经 marks a past experience that is over, so 过 goes right after 学. 了 does not go with 曾经, and 着 would mean you are still learning.

items.q: 这个病我以前得___，所以知道怎么办。
items.zh: 这个病我以前得过，所以知道怎么办。
items.py: zhè ge bìng wǒ yǐ qián dé guo suǒ yǐ zhī dào zěn me bàn
items.en: I had this illness before, so I know what to do.
items.why: 所以知道怎么办 says the past case gives you knowledge now, which is the job of 过. 了 would report one event and leave no reason for 所以.

items.q: 他在国外读___书，所以英语很好。
items.zh: 他在国外读过书，所以英语很好。
items.py: tā zài guó wài dú guo shū suǒ yǐ yīng yǔ hěn hǎo
items.en: He has studied abroad, so his English is good.
items.why: The study abroad is a past experience that explains his English now: 过 after 读. 读着书 means he is studying at this moment.

items.q: 我以前跟这位经理合作___，所以很了解他的工作习惯。
items.zh: 我以前跟这位经理合作过，所以很了解他的工作习惯。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián gēn zhè wèi jīng lǐ hé zuò guo suǒ yǐ hěn liǎo jiě tā de gōng zuò xí guàn
items.en: I have worked with this manager before, so I know his work habits well.
items.why: 以前 and 所以很了解 present the past cooperation as experience, so 过. 合作了 with nothing after it is incomplete, and 合作着 would mean you are working together now.

items.q: 我爸爸年轻时踢___足球，现在膝盖不好。
items.zh: 我爸爸年轻时踢过足球，现在膝盖不好。
items.py: wǒ bà ba nián qīng shí tī guo zú qiú xiàn zài xī gài bù hǎo
items.en: My dad played football when he was young; now his knees are bad.
items.why: 年轻时 versus 现在 shows the activity is over and in the past: 过. 踢着足球 would say he is playing right now.

items.q: 我以前在那家医院住___，护士都很好。
items.zh: 我以前在那家医院住过，护士都很好。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài nà jiā yī yuàn zhù guo hù shi dōu hěn hǎo
items.en: I stayed at that hospital before; the nurses were all very nice.
items.why: 以前 gives a finished stay used as experience: 过. 住着 would mean you are staying there now, and bare 住了 leaves the clause open.

items.q: 他以前做___老师，所以很会讲道理。
items.zh: 他以前做过老师，所以很会讲道理。
items.py: tā yǐ qián zuò guo lǎo shī suǒ yǐ hěn huì jiǎng dào lǐ
items.en: He used to be a teacher, so he is good at explaining things.
items.why: The past job is experience that explains his skill now, so 过 after 做. 做着老师 would mean he is a teacher at present, which 以前 rules out.

items.q: 她曾经在一家大医院当___护士长，所以很会管理病人。
items.zh: 她曾经在一家大医院当过护士长，所以很会管理病人。
items.py: tā céng jīng zài yī jiā dà yī yuàn dāng guo hù shi zhǎng suǒ yǐ hěn huì guǎn lǐ bìng rén
items.en: She was once a head nurse at a big hospital, so she is good at managing patients.
items.why: 曾经 pairs with 过 for a finished stretch of past experience. 当着 would be a current job, and 当了 reports becoming one rather than having been one.

items.q: 我妈妈教___书，所以她很会说话。
items.zh: 我妈妈教过书，所以她很会说话。
items.py: wǒ mā ma jiāo guo shū suǒ yǐ tā hěn huì shuō huà
items.en: My mom has taught school, so she is good at talking.
items.why: Past teaching experience that explains a present skill takes 过. 教了书 would only report that she taught and gives no experience reading.

items.q: 王经理年轻的时候也曾经当___兵，所以身体特别好。
items.zh: 王经理年轻的时候也曾经当过兵，所以身体特别好。
items.py: wáng jīng lǐ nián qīng de shí hou yě céng jīng dāng guo bīng suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ tè bié hǎo
items.en: Manager Wang also served in the army when he was young, so he is in great shape.
items.why: 曾经 plus 年轻的时候 marks a finished stretch of past experience: 过. 当着兵 would mean he is a soldier now, and 了 does not go with 曾经.

items.q: 老板以前也在小公司做___，所以他很理解我们的难处。
items.zh: 老板以前也在小公司做过，所以他很理解我们的难处。
items.py: lǎo bǎn yǐ qián yě zài xiǎo gōng sī zuò guo suǒ yǐ tā hěn lǐ jiě wǒ men de nán chu
items.en: The boss has also worked at a small company, so he understands our difficulties.
items.why: His earlier job is experience that explains his understanding now: 过. 做了 with no object or result is incomplete, and 做着 would put him in a small company now.

items.q: 我弟弟小时候曾经吃___这种水果，所以不喜欢。
items.zh: 我弟弟小时候曾经吃过这种水果，所以不喜欢。
items.py: wǒ dì di xiǎo shí hou céng jīng chī guo zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ suǒ yǐ bù xǐ huan
items.en: My younger brother tried this fruit as a child, so he does not like it.
items.why: 曾经 marks past experience that explains a present dislike: 过. 着 means eating is in progress now, and 了 does not go with 曾经.

items.q: 我们以前见___面___。
items.zh: 我们以前见过面。
items.py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We have met before.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object (见 + 面), so 过 goes between them: 见过面. 见面过 puts 过 after the object, and doubling it is wrong.

items.q: 他结___婚___，现在一个人住。
items.zh: 他结过婚，现在一个人住。
items.py: tā jié guo hūn xiàn zài yī ge rén zhù
items.en: He has been married before; now he lives alone.
items.why: 结婚 is a verb-object word, so 过 splits it: 结过婚. 结婚过 is the learner error, and 结婚了 would say he is married now, which clashes with 一个人住.

items.q: 我们在公司的晚会上跳___舞___。
items.zh: 我们在公司的晚会上跳过舞。
items.py: wǒ men zài gōng sī de wǎn huì shàng tiào guo wǔ
items.en: We have danced at a company party.
items.why: 跳舞 is 跳 + 舞, so 过 sits right after 跳. Placing it after the object, as in 跳舞过, is not Chinese.

items.q: 小王在这家公司加___班___。
items.zh: 小王在这家公司加过班。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zài zhè jiā gōng sī jiā guo bān
items.en: Xiao Wang has worked overtime at this company.
items.why: 加班 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it. 加班过 attaches 过 after the object, which is the classic mistake.

items.q: 你在海边游___泳___吗？
items.zh: 你在海边游过泳吗？
items.py: nǐ zài hǎi biān yóu guo yǒng ma
items.en: Have you ever swum at the seaside?
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 follows 游: 游过泳. 游泳过 misplaces 过 after the object.

items.q: 听说李经理年轻的时候在国外留___学___。
items.zh: 听说李经理年轻的时候在国外留过学。
items.py: tīng shuō lǐ jīng lǐ nián qīng de shí hou zài guó wài liú guo xué
items.en: I heard Manager Li studied abroad when he was young.
items.why: 留学 is 留 + 学, a verb-object word, so 过 goes after 留. 留学过 puts 过 after the object.

items.q: 我___去过那家医院，不知道在哪儿。
items.zh: 我没去过那家医院，不知道在哪儿。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā yī yuàn bù zhī dào zài nǎ r
items.en: I have never been to that hospital, so I don't know where it is.
items.why: 过 is negated by 没: 没去过 means never been. 不去过 does not exist, 别 is a command, and 都 makes no sense here.

items.q: 他___吃过北京烤鸭。
items.zh: 他没有吃过北京烤鸭。
items.py: tā méi yǒu chī guo běi jīng kǎo yā
items.en: He has never eaten Beijing roast duck.
items.why: The negative of V过 is 没有 (or 没) and 过 stays. 不 cannot go with 过, and 别 and 很 do not fit.

items.q: 我没吃过这种药___，不知道有没有用。
items.zh: 我没吃过这种药，不知道有没有用。
items.py: wǒ méi chī guo zhè zhǒng yào bù zhī dào yǒu méi yǒu yòng
items.en: I have never taken this medicine, so I don't know if it works.
items.why: After 没 … 过 nothing more is added: 没 already denies the event, so a final 了 is wrong.

items.q: 他来这家公司三年了，还___请过假。
items.zh: 他来这家公司三年了，还没请过假。
items.py: tā lái zhè jiā gōng sī sān nián le hái méi qǐng guo jià
items.en: He has been at this company three years and still hasn't taken any leave.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 is "not yet, never so far". 还不请过假 is impossible because 过 only takes 没.

items.q: 这个病我没得___，所以不太了解。
items.zh: 这个病我没得过，所以不太了解。
items.py: zhè ge bìng wǒ méi dé guo suǒ yǐ bù tài liǎo jiě
items.en: I've never had this illness, so I don't know much about it.
items.why: 没 … 过 is the pattern for never having had it, and 过 stays after the verb. 着 and 的 are not used with 没 here.

items.q: 我小时候很健康，一次医院也没住___。
items.zh: 我小时候很健康，一次医院也没住过。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn jiàn kāng yī cì yī yuàn yě méi zhù guo
items.en: I was very healthy as a child and was never in hospital once.
items.why: 一次…也没 is an emphatic never, and 没 requires 过 on the verb: 没住过. 没住了 is not a sentence.

items.q: 小王来公司已经半年了，可是还没跟经理单独开___会。
items.zh: 小王来公司已经半年了，可是还没跟经理单独开过会。
items.py: xiǎo wáng lái gōng sī yǐ jīng bàn nián le kě shì hái méi gēn jīng lǐ dān dú kāi guo huì
items.en: Xiao Wang has been at the company half a year but has not yet had a one-on-one meeting with the manager.
items.why: 还没 … 过 says it has never happened up to now. 还没开了 and 还没开着 are not possible, because 没 rejects 了 and 着 here.

items.q: 这么多年来，他连一天假都没请___。
items.zh: 这么多年来，他连一天假都没请过。
items.py: zhè me duō nián lái tā lián yī tiān jià dōu méi qǐng guo
items.en: In all these years he has not taken even one day off.
items.why: 这么多年来 covers his whole past up to now, so 没请过. 没请了 is ungrammatical, since 了 cannot follow 没.

items.q: 他去___上海，下个星期回来。
items.zh: 他去了上海，下个星期回来。
items.py: tā qù le shàng hǎi xià ge xīng qī huí lái
items.en: He has gone to Shanghai and will be back next week.
items.why: He is away now and returns next week, so the trip is a completed event whose result still holds: 了. 去过 would mean he has already been and come back.

items.q: 这个电影我以前看___，不想再看了。
items.zh: 这个电影我以前看过，不想再看了。
items.py: zhè ge diàn yǐng wǒ yǐ qián kàn guo bù xiǎng zài kàn le
items.en: I've seen this film before and don't want to watch it again.
items.why: 以前 and 不想再看 cite past experience: 过. 了 narrates one viewing, and 着 means the film is on right now.

items.q: 医生去___病房，一会儿就回来。
items.zh: 医生去了病房，一会儿就回来。
items.py: yī shēng qù le bìng fáng yī huì r jiù huí lái
items.en: The doctor has gone to the ward and will be right back.
items.why: The doctor is away right now and returns soon, so the result of the trip still holds: 了. 去过 would mean he went and is already back.

items.q: 昨天晚上我们开___一个很长的会，大家都很累。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我们开了一个很长的会，大家都很累。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men kāi le yī ge hěn cháng de huì dà jiā dōu hěn lèi
items.en: We had a very long meeting last night and everyone is tired.
items.why: Telling what happened on one specific evening, with a counted object, takes 了. 过 would present it as life experience, which is odd for a single named night.

items.q: 他去___外地出差，现在还没回来。
items.zh: 他去了外地出差，现在还没回来。
items.py: tā qù le wài dì chū chāi xiàn zài hái méi huí lái
items.en: He has gone away on a business trip and isn't back yet.
items.why: 现在还没回来 means he is still away, so the trip is an event with a lasting result: 了. 过 says the trip is over and he is back.

items.q: 小李来___，你快去见他。
items.zh: 小李来了，你快去见他。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ lái le nǐ kuài qù jiàn tā
items.en: Xiao Li is here; go and see him quickly.
items.why: Xiao Li has arrived and is here now, so the result holds: 了. 来过 would mean he came and has left.

items.q: 昨天下午我去医院检查___身体，医生说我没问题。
items.zh: 昨天下午我去医院检查了身体，医生说我没问题。
items.py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá le shēn tǐ yī shēng shuō wǒ méi wèn tí
items.en: Yesterday afternoon I went to the hospital for a checkup, and the doctor said I was fine.
items.why: A chain of events on a named afternoon (go, check, doctor says) is narration, so 了. 过 would only mention the checkup as experience.

items.q: 老板今天早上开___三个会，现在在休息，你下午再来吧。
items.zh: 老板今天早上开了三个会，现在在休息，你下午再来吧。
items.py: lǎo bǎn jīn tiān zǎo shang kāi le sān ge huì xiàn zài zài xiū xi nǐ xià wǔ zài lái ba
items.en: The boss had three meetings this morning and is resting now; come back this afternoon.
items.why: This morning plus the boss resting now is a specific completed event with a present result: 了. 过 would sound like a general record of meetings he has had.

items.q: 他以前做___部门经理，现在是普通职员。
items.zh: 他以前做过部门经理，现在是普通职员。
items.py: tā yǐ qián zuò guo bù mén jīng lǐ xiàn zài shì pǔ tōng zhí yuán
items.en: He used to be a department manager; now he is an ordinary employee.
items.why: 以前 against 现在 shows the job is over: 过. 做着 would mean he is a manager now, and 做了 would imply the result still holds.

items.q: 我去过___次那家医院。
items.zh: 我去过两次那家医院。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì nà jiā yī yuàn
items.en: I have been to that hospital twice.
items.why: Before the measure 次, "two" is 两, not 二. 第 and 个 do not make a count of occasions here.

items.q: 这个同事我只见过三___。
items.zh: 这个同事我只见过三次。
items.py: zhè ge tóng shì wǒ zhǐ jiàn guo sān cì
items.en: I have met this colleague only three times.
items.why: Meetings are occasions, counted with 次. 遍 counts a whole run-through of something like a book, not meeting a person.

items.q: 我找过___他___，他都不在办公室。
items.zh: 我找过他两次，他都不在办公室。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo guo tā liǎng cì tā dōu bù zài bàn gōng shì
items.en: I have looked for him twice and he wasn't in the office either time.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 找过他两次. 找过两次他 puts a pronoun after the number, which Chinese does not do.

items.q: 不用了，我吃___了，谢谢。
items.zh: 不用了，我吃过了，谢谢。
items.py: bù yòng le wǒ chī guo le xiè xie
items.en: No need, I've already eaten, thanks.
items.why: V过了 turns down an offer: the meal is already done. 着 and 的 cannot sit before the final 了, and 会 would mean "will eat".

items.q: 早饭我已经吃___了，你不用给我留。
items.zh: 早饭我已经吃过了，你不用给我留。
items.py: zǎo fàn wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le nǐ bù yòng gěi wǒ liú
items.en: I've already had breakfast; you don't need to save any for me.
items.why: 已经 … 过了 reports a routine thing as already done. 吃着了 and 吃的了 are not sentences.

items.q: 你洗___澡了吗？
items.zh: 你洗过澡了吗？
items.py: nǐ xǐ guo zǎo le ma
items.en: Have you had your shower yet?
items.why: Asking whether a routine action is done yet is V过…了吗. 洗着澡了吗 or 洗会澡了吗 do not form a question about completion.

items.q: 病人的血压，护士已经量___了。
items.zh: 病人的血压，护士已经量过了。
items.py: bìng rén de xuè yā hù shi yǐ jīng liáng guo le
items.en: The nurse has already taken the patient's blood pressure.
items.why: 已经 + V过 + 了 says the routine check is already done. 量着了 does not exist, and 量会了 is meaningless.

items.q: 他的药还没___呢，你提醒他一下。
items.zh: 他的药还没吃呢，你提醒他一下。
items.py: tā de yào hái méi chī ne nǐ tí xǐng tā yī xià
items.en: He has not taken his medicine yet; remind him.
items.why: The negative of "already done" is 还没 + bare verb + 呢. 还没吃过了 and 还没吃了 are impossible, and 还没吃过 would mean he has never taken it.

items.q: 会议室我已经打扫___了，大家可以进去了。
items.zh: 会议室我已经打扫过了，大家可以进去了。
items.py: huì yì shì wǒ yǐ jīng dǎ sǎo guo le dà jiā kě yǐ jìn qù le
items.en: I have already cleaned the meeting room; everyone can go in now.
items.why: Routine task already done: 已经 + V过 + 了. 打扫着了 and 打扫会了 are not possible.

items.q: 你做___这种检查吗？
items.zh: 你做过这种检查吗？
items.py: nǐ zuò guo zhè zhǒng jiǎn chá ma
items.en: Have you ever had this kind of examination?
items.why: "Have you ever" is V过 … 吗. 了 would ask whether you did it on one occasion, and 着 means doing it right now.

items.q: 你有没有请过假___？
items.zh: 你有没有请过假？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu qǐng guo jià
items.en: Have you ever taken leave?
items.why: 有没有 already makes it a question, so no 吗 is added. 有没有请过假吗 doubles the question markers.

items.q: 你写___写过这种报告？
items.zh: 你写没写过这种报告？
items.py: nǐ xiě méi xiě guo zhè zhǒng bào gào
items.en: Have you ever written this kind of report?
items.why: A-not-A with 过 uses 没: 写没写过. 写不写过 is wrong because 不 cannot go with 过.

items.q: 你问我写过报告没有？我___，写过很多。
items.zh: 你问我写过报告没有？我写过，写过很多。
items.py: nǐ wèn wǒ xiě guo bào gào méi yǒu wǒ xiě guo xiě guo hěn duō
items.en: You ask whether I have written reports? Yes, many.
items.why: A yes answer to a 过 question repeats the verb with 过. 写了 would answer a question about one event, and 是的 or 不是 cannot answer it.

items.q: 你看过___次医生？
items.zh: 你看过几次医生？
items.py: nǐ kàn guo jǐ cì yī shēng
items.en: How many times have you seen a doctor?
items.why: "How many times" is 几次, placed after 过. 什么, 怎么 and 哪个 do not stand before the measure 次.

items.q: 我从来___生过病。
items.zh: 我从来没生过病。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi shēng guo bìng
items.en: I have never been ill.
items.why: 从来没 + verb + 过 means never once up to now. 从来不 cannot take 过, since 不 describes habit and 过 describes experience.

items.q: 医生说我很健康，我从来没生___大病。
items.zh: 医生说我很健康，我从来没生过大病。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ hěn jiàn kāng wǒ cóng lái méi shēng guo dà bìng
items.en: The doctor says I am healthy; I have never had a serious illness.
items.why: 从来没 requires 过 on the verb. 了 and 着 cannot follow 没 here.

items.q: 我从来___喝咖啡，因为喝了就睡不着。
items.zh: 我从来不喝咖啡，因为喝了就睡不着。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē kā fēi yīn wèi hē le jiù shuì bù zháo
items.en: I never drink coffee, because I cannot sleep if I do.
items.why: There is no 过 and the point is a habit, so 从来不. 从来没 needs 过 to say "never once" and sounds incomplete without it.

items.q: 我从来没见过这么爱加班___人。
items.zh: 我从来没见过这么爱加班的人。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me ài jiā bān de rén
items.en: I have never seen anyone so fond of working overtime.
items.why: 从来没见过这么 + description + 的 + noun: the 的 links the description to 人. 得 and 地 attach to verbs or adverbs, and 了 does not belong here.

items.zh: 我看过那个医生。
items.py: wǒ kàn guo nà ge yī shēng
items.en: I have seen that doctor before.
items.why: 过 stays on the verb 看 and the object follows it. 过 cannot move behind 医生.

items.zh: 他在这家公司加过班。
items.py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī jiā guo bān
items.en: He has worked overtime at this company.
items.why: 加班 is split by 过. The place phrase stays before the verb, either before or after the subject.

items.zh: 我见过他两次。
items.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
items.en: I have met him twice.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count, so 他 comes before 两次. 见过两次他 is wrong.

items.zh: 小王迟到过两次。
items.py: xiǎo wáng chí dào guo liǎng cì
items.en: Xiao Wang has been late twice.
items.why: The count follows 过. Nothing else can come between 过 and 两次.

items.zh: 我去过两次医院。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì yī yuàn
items.en: I have been to the hospital twice.
items.why: With a place object the count may go before or after it; 过 stays right after 去.

items.zh: 我没打过针。
items.py: wǒ méi dǎ guo zhēn
items.en: I have never had an injection.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb and 过 splits the verb-object word 打针. 不 and 了 are not used.

items.zh: 他没来过这家公司。
items.py: tā méi lái guo zhè jiā gōng sī
items.en: He has never been to this company.
items.why: 没 comes before the verb and 过 stays after it. The place may be fronted as a topic.

items.zh: 我从来没发过烧。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi fā guo shāo
items.en: I have never had a fever.
items.why: 从来 comes before 没, and 过 splits 发烧. 从来 cannot follow 没.

items.zh: 你有没有打过针？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu dǎ guo zhēn
items.en: Have you ever had an injection?
items.why: 有没有 goes before the verb and 过 splits 打针. No 吗 is needed.

items.zh: 你吃过这种药吗？
items.py: nǐ chī guo zhè zhǒng yào ma
items.en: Have you ever taken this medicine?
items.why: 吗 closes the question and 过 follows 吃. The object may be fronted as a topic.

items.zh: 我已经吃过药了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo yào le
items.en: I have already taken my medicine.
items.why: 已经 comes before the verb, 过 sits right after it and 了 ends the clause. The object may be fronted.

items.zh: 你吃过饭了吗？
items.py: nǐ chī guo fàn le ma
items.en: Have you eaten yet?
items.why: V过…了吗 asks if a routine thing is already done. 过 follows 吃, and 了 comes before 吗.

items.zh: 他去了医院，下午才回来。
items.py: tā qù le yī yuàn xià wǔ cái huí lái
items.en: He has gone to the hospital and won't be back until the afternoon.
items.why: He is away now, so the trip takes 了 straight after 去. 过 would say he already came back.

items.zh: 他在国外生活过十年。
items.py: tā zài guó wài shēng huó guo shí nián
items.en: He lived abroad for ten years.
items.why: The place phrase comes before the verb and 过 follows the verb; the length of time comes last. 在国外 may be fronted.

items.task: Say you have never been there.
items.zh: 我没去过那家医院。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā yī yuàn
items.en: I have never been to that hospital.
items.why: Negate with 没 and keep 过. 不 and 了 are wrong here.
