items.zh: 你看过这位医生吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn guo zhè wèi yī shēng ma
items.en: Have you seen this doctor before?
items.why: Add 吗 at the end and keep 过. The A-not-A form would need 没, never 不.

items.src_py: nǐ chī guo zhè zhǒng yào
items.task: Turn it into a question ending in 没有.
items.zh: 你吃过这种药没有？
items.py: nǐ chī guo zhè zhǒng yào méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever taken this medicine?
items.why: 没有 at the end is the 过 counterpart of 吗, and it replaces 吗 rather than joining it.

items.task: Ask with 有没有 before the verb.
items.zh: 他有没有迟到过？
items.py: tā yǒu méi yǒu chí dào guo
items.en: Has he ever been late?
items.why: 有没有 goes before the verb and 过 stays after it. No 吗 is added.

items.task: Say you asked him twice.
items.zh: 我问过他两次。
items.py: wǒ wèn guo tā liǎng cì
items.en: I have asked him twice.
items.why: The count follows 过, but a pronoun object like 他 comes before it.

items.src_py: wǒ jiǎn chá guo zhè fèn bào gào
items.task: Say you checked it three times, using 三遍.
items.zh: 我检查过这份报告三遍。
items.py: wǒ jiǎn chá guo zhè fèn bào gào sān biàn
items.en: I have checked this report three times.
items.why: 遍 counts going through the whole thing. The count follows 过, with the ordinary object either after it or fronted.

items.task: Say you have never once been late, using 从来.
items.zh: 我从来没迟到过。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi chí dào guo
items.en: I have never been late.
items.why: 从来 goes before 没 and 过 stays after the verb. 从来 cannot follow 没.

items.task: Ask whether the medicine has already been taken, using 过 and 了.
items.zh: 你吃过药了吗？
items.py: nǐ chī guo yào le ma
items.en: Have you taken your medicine yet?
items.why: V过…了吗 asks whether a routine thing is already done. 过 goes after 吃 and 了 before 吗.

items.src_py: tā yǐ qián shì lǎo shī
items.task: Say he used to be a teacher, using 当过.
items.zh: 他以前当过老师。
items.py: tā yǐ qián dāng guo lǎo shī
items.en: He used to be a teacher.
items.why: 过 after 当 marks a past job that is over. 以前 may come before or after the subject.

items.task: Say you have never drunk coffee, using 从来 and 过.
items.zh: 我从来没喝过咖啡。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi hē guo kā fēi
items.en: I have never drunk coffee.
items.why: "Never once" is 从来没 + verb + 过. 从来不 would be a habit and takes no 过.

items.s_py: wǒ bù zhù guo yuàn
items.zh: 我没住过院。
items.py: wǒ méi zhù guo yuàn
items.en: I have never been in hospital.
items.why: 过 is negated with 没. 不 can never go with 过.

items.s_py: tā kàn yī shēng guo
items.zh: 他看过医生。
items.py: tā kàn guo yī shēng
items.en: He has seen a doctor before.
items.why: 过 attaches to the verb 看, before the object. At the end of the sentence it is wrong.

items.s_py: wǒ zài hǎi biān yóu yǒng guo
items.zh: 我在海边游过泳。
items.py: wǒ zài hǎi biān yóu guo yǒng
items.en: I have swum at the seaside.
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 游过泳. 游泳过 is wrong.

items.s_py: wǒ pèng jiàn guo liǎng cì tā
items.zh: 我碰见过她两次。
items.py: wǒ pèng jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
items.en: I have run into her twice.
items.why: A pronoun object must come before the count: 碰见过她两次.

items.s_py: wǒ qù sān cì guo yī yuàn
items.zh: 我去过三次医院。
items.py: wǒ qù guo sān cì yī yuàn
items.en: I have been to the hospital three times.
items.why: 过 must follow the verb directly. The count 三次 comes after 过.

items.s_py: nǐ qù bù qù guo yī yuàn
items.zh: 你去没去过医院？
items.py: nǐ qù méi qù guo yī yuàn
items.en: Have you ever been to the hospital?
items.why: The negative of 过 is 没, so the A-not-A form is 去没去过. 去不去过 is wrong.

items.s_py: tā cóng lái bù hē guo jiǔ
items.zh: 他从来没喝过酒。
items.py: tā cóng lái méi hē guo jiǔ
items.en: He has never drunk alcohol.
items.why: 过 requires 没. 从来不 is only for habit and takes no 过.

items.s_py: wǒ méi cóng lái kàn guo zhōng yī
items.zh: 我从来没看过中医。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi kàn guo zhōng yī
items.en: I have never seen a Chinese medicine doctor.
items.why: 从来 must come before 没, not after it.

items.s_py: wǒ hái méi chī guo zǎo fàn le
items.zh: 我还没吃早饭呢。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī zǎo fàn ne
items.en: I haven't had breakfast yet.
items.why: The negative of "already done" is 还没 + verb (+ 呢). 过 and 了 cannot both follow 没.

items.s: 经理去过北京开会，明天才回来。
items.s_py: jīng lǐ qù guo běi jīng kāi huì míng tiān cái huí lái
items.zh: 经理去了北京开会，明天才回来。
items.py: jīng lǐ qù le běi jīng kāi huì míng tiān cái huí lái
items.en: The manager has gone to Beijing for a meeting and won't be back until tomorrow.
items.why: He is still away until tomorrow, so the trip takes 了. 过 would mean the trip is over.

items.s_py: zhè piān wén zhāng wǒ dú sān biàn guo
items.zh: 这篇文章我读过三遍。
items.py: zhè piān wén zhāng wǒ dú guo sān biàn
items.en: I have read this article three times.
items.why: 过 must sit right after the verb and the count follows it.

items.s: 小王去了医院，现在还没回来。
items.zh: 小王去了医院，现在还没回来。
items.py: xiǎo wáng qù le yī yuàn xiàn zài hái méi huí lái
items.en: Xiao Wang has gone to the hospital and isn't back yet.
items.why: He is still away, so 了 is right. 去过 would claim he already came back.

items.s: 这个故事我听过很多遍。
items.zh: 这个故事我听过很多遍。
items.py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn
items.en: I have heard this story many times.
items.why: 过 follows the verb and 遍 counts whole run-throughs of a story. The fronted object is natural.

items.s: 他吃过药了，你不用担心。
items.zh: 他吃过药了，你不用担心。
items.py: tā chī guo yào le nǐ bù yòng dān xīn
items.en: He has already taken his medicine, so don't worry.
items.why: V过…了 means a routine thing is already done, not life experience. The object sits between 过 and 了.

items.zh: 我从来不吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù chī zǎo fàn
items.en: I never eat breakfast.
items.why: Here the point is a habit, so 从来不 without 过 is correct. 从来不吃过 would be wrong.

items.zh: 我还没看过这份报告。
items.py: wǒ hái méi kàn guo zhè fèn bào gào
items.en: I haven't read this report yet.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 means not yet so far, and 过 stays. 还没看了 would be wrong.

items.zh: 你量过体温了吗？
items.py: nǐ liáng guo tǐ wēn le ma
items.en: Have you taken your temperature yet?
items.why: V过…了吗 asks whether a routine check is already done. The 过 and 了 are both right.

items.zh: 医生刚才来过。
items.py: yī shēng gāng cái lái guo
items.en: The doctor came by just now.
items.why: 过 can go with 刚才: the visit is over and the doctor has left. 刚才来了 would imply he is still here.

items.zh: 我在这家医院看过病。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè jiā yī yuàn kàn guo bìng
items.en: I have been treated at this hospital.
items.why: 看病 is verb + object, so 过 follows 看. The place phrase stays before the verb.

items.zh: 你有没有加过班？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu jiā guo bān
items.en: Have you ever worked overtime?
items.why: 有没有 before the verb is a valid question form for 过, and it takes no 吗.

items.q: 你见过他几___？
items.zh: 你见过他几次？
items.py: nǐ jiàn guo tā jǐ cì
items.en: How many times have you met him?
items.why: Meetings are counted as occasions: 几次, after the pronoun 他. 遍 means a whole run-through and does not suit meeting someone.

items.q: 小王不在，他去___北京出差，周五才回来。
items.zh: 小王不在，他去了北京出差，周五才回来。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bù zài tā qù le běi jīng chū chāi zhōu wǔ cái huí lái
items.en: Xiao Wang isn't here; he has gone to Beijing on a business trip and won't be back until Friday.
items.why: 不在 and 周五才回来 show the trip is still going on, so a completed event whose result holds: 了. 过 would say he has been and returned.

items.s: 小王刚才来过，说下午再来找你。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng gāng cái lái guo shuō xià wǔ zài lái zhǎo nǐ
items.zh: 小王刚才来过，说下午再来找你。
items.py: xiǎo wáng gāng cái lái guo shuō xià wǔ zài lái zhǎo nǐ
items.en: Xiao Wang came by just now and said he would come back for you this afternoon.
items.why: 过 is fine with 刚才: it says he came and has left again, which fits 'will come again this afternoon'.

items.src_py: wǒ méi dǎ guo gāo ěr fū qiú
items.task: Ask 'you' with a 没有 question.
items.zh: 你打过高尔夫球没有？
items.py: nǐ dǎ guo gāo ěr fū qiú méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever played golf?
items.why: The question keeps 过 and ends with 没有. The A-not-A form with 不 is never used.

items.s_py: wǒ men dǎ lán qiú guo
items.zh: 我们打过篮球。
items.py: wǒ men dǎ guo lán qiú
items.en: We have played basketball.
items.why: 过 must sit right after the verb 打, before the object. At the end of the sentence it is left hanging.

items.q: 他爱踢球，但是还___参加过正式的比赛，所以有点紧张。
items.zh: 他爱踢球，但是还没参加过正式的比赛，所以有点紧张。
items.py: tā ài tī qiú dàn shì hái méi cān jiā guo zhèng shì de bǐ sài suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng
items.en: He loves playing football but has never taken part in an official match, so he is a bit nervous.
items.why: 没参加过 negates experience and 过 stays. 还不参加过 is impossible, because 不 and 过 never combine.

items.s: 我们昨天打了一场篮球，今天腿很酸。
items.s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān dǎ le yī chǎng lán qiú jīn tiān tuǐ hěn suān
items.zh: 我们昨天打了一场篮球，今天腿很酸。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān dǎ le yī chǎng lán qiú jīn tiān tuǐ hěn suān
items.en: We played a game of basketball yesterday, and my legs are sore today.
items.why: One specific game yesterday with a lasting result is told with 了. 过 would only say we have played basketball at some time.

items.s_py: tā men yǐ qián jiàn miàn guo
items.zh: 他们以前见过面。
items.py: tā men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
items.en: They have met before.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 见过面. 见面过 is not possible.

items.q: 他曾经在国家队踢___球，现在已经当教练了。
items.zh: 他曾经在国家队踢过球，现在已经当教练了。
items.py: tā céng jīng zài guó jiā duì tī guo qiú xiàn zài yǐ jīng dāng jiào liàn le
items.en: He once played football for the national team and is a coach now.
items.why: 曾经 marks a finished stretch of the past, so 过 follows the verb 踢 inside 踢球. 了 clashes with 曾经, and 着 would mean he is still playing.

items.q: 他去___上海，下个星期才回来。
items.zh: 他去了上海，下个星期才回来。
items.py: tā qù le shàng hǎi xià ge xīng qī cái huí lái
items.en: He has gone to Shanghai and won't be back until next week.
items.why: 下个星期才回来 means he is still away, so the trip is a completed event with a lasting result: 了. 过 would mean he went and is already back.

items.q: 这家店我以前来___，东西不便宜。
items.zh: 这家店我以前来过，东西不便宜。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn wǒ yǐ qián lái guo dōng xi bù pián yi
items.en: I have been to this shop before, and the things there aren't cheap.
items.why: 以前 plus knowing the prices points to experience: 来过. 来了 would only report that I arrived, so it cannot carry 'I have been here before'.

items.zh: 我从来没玩过这种游戏。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi wán guo zhè zhǒng yóu xì
items.en: I have never played this kind of game.
items.why: The chain is 从来 + 没 + verb + 过, in that order. 从来 must come before 没, and the object may be fronted as a topic.

items.task: Turn it into a 有没有 question.
items.zh: 你有没有打过网球？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu dǎ guo wǎng qiú
items.en: Have you ever played tennis?
items.why: 有没有 goes before 打过, and no 吗 follows. The object may be fronted as a topic.

items.q: 你以前看___这个电影吗？
items.zh: 你以前看过这个电影吗？
items.py: nǐ yǐ qián kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng ma
items.en: Have you ever seen this film?
items.why: 以前 and 'ever' ask about experience, so 过. 了 would ask whether you watched it on one particular occasion.

items.q: 你去___去过那家新开的运动用品店？听说里面的东西很全。
items.zh: 你去没去过那家新开的运动用品店？听说里面的东西很全。
items.py: nǐ qù méi qù guo nà jiā xīn kāi de yùn dòng yòng pǐn diàn tīng shuō lǐ miàn de dōng xi hěn quán
items.en: Have you been to that newly opened sports shop? I hear they have everything.
items.why: The A-not-A form of 去过 is 去没去过, built on 没. 去不去过 is wrong because 不 never goes with 过.

items.q: 我昨天买___一双球鞋，今天就穿上了。
items.zh: 我昨天买了一双球鞋，今天就穿上了。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié jīn tiān jiù chuān shang le
items.en: I bought a pair of sneakers yesterday and put them on today.
items.why: One specific purchase told as part of a story (买, then 穿上) takes 了. 过 would only say I have bought sneakers at some time, not this pair.

items.q: 他说已经问___老板了，老板同意给我们打九折。
items.zh: 他说已经问过老板了，老板同意给我们打九折。
items.py: tā shuō yǐ jīng wèn guo lǎo bǎn le lǎo bǎn tóng yì gěi wǒ men dǎ jiǔ zhé
items.en: He says he has already asked the boss, and the boss agreed to give us 10% off.
items.why: 问过老板了 = the asking is already done. 着 would mean he is asking at this moment, which does not fit 已经…同意.

items.task: Say you have never been, not even once (use 从来).
items.zh: 我从来没去过北京。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo běi jīng
items.en: I have never been to Beijing.
items.why: 从来 comes before 没 and 过 stays on the verb: 从来没去过. 从来不去过 is impossible.

items.src: 我从来没买过贵的球鞋。
items.src_py: wǒ cóng lái méi mǎi guo guì de qiú xié
items.task: Change it to a habit: you never buy them.
items.zh: 我从来不买贵的球鞋。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù mǎi guì de qiú xié
items.en: I never buy expensive sneakers.
items.why: A habit takes 从来不 and no 过; 从来没…过 is about your whole past up to now. Putting 过 after 不 is wrong.

items.q: 你有没有___过这种球鞋？
items.zh: 你有没有穿过这种球鞋？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu chuān guo zhè zhǒng qiú xié
items.en: Have you ever worn this type of sneaker?
items.why: 有没有 comes before the bare verb and 过 follows it: 有没有穿过. 了 and 着 are not added, and 不穿 would be a different question.

items.q: 我妈妈年轻时跳___舞，还拿过奖。
items.zh: 我妈妈年轻时跳过舞，还拿过奖。
items.py: wǒ mā ma nián qīng shí tiào guo wǔ hái ná guo jiǎng
items.en: My mother used to dance when she was young and even won a prize.
items.why: 年轻时 puts it firmly in the past as part of her experience, so 过 goes inside 跳舞. 着 would mean she is dancing right now, and 了 cannot split 跳舞 like this.

items.q: 我从来___喝咖啡，因为喝了晚上就睡不着。
items.zh: 我从来不喝咖啡，因为喝了晚上就睡不着。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē kā fēi yīn wèi hē le wǎn shang jiù shuì bu zháo
items.en: I never drink coffee, because if I do I can't sleep at night.
items.why: A habit with no 过 takes 从来不: 'I never drink it'. 从来没 would need 过 to say 'never once', and 别 is only for commands.

items.q: 这部电视剧我从头到尾看过两___，连台词都记住了。
items.zh: 这部电视剧我从头到尾看过两遍，连台词都记住了。
items.py: zhè bù diàn shì jù wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi kàn guo liǎng biàn lián tái cí dōu jì zhù le
items.en: I've watched this TV series from beginning to end twice, and I even remember the lines.
items.why: 从头到尾 means a full run-through, which takes 遍. 个, 位 and 件 are not counters for repeating an action.

items.q: 我___去过上海，很想去看看。
items.zh: 我没去过上海，很想去看看。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi hěn xiǎng qù kàn kan
items.en: I have never been to Shanghai and would love to see it.
items.why: 过 is negated with 没, never 不: 没去过 = have never been. 不去过 does not exist, and 别 is for commands.

items.q: “你滑过雪吗？”“___，我很想试试。”
items.zh: “你滑过雪吗？”“没滑过，我很想试试。”
items.py: nǐ huá guo xuě ma méi huá guo wǒ hěn xiǎng shì shi
items.en: "Have you ever skied?" "No, I haven't, but I'd love to try."
items.why: The answer repeats the verb with 没 and 过: 没滑过. 不滑 means 'I don't ski', which clashes with 'I'd love to try'.

items.q: 我在海边游___泳___，水很清。
items.zh: 我在海边游过泳，水很清。
items.py: wǒ zài hǎi biān yóu guo yǒng shuǐ hěn qīng
items.en: I have swum at the seaside; the water was clear.
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 goes after 游. 游泳过 is wrong because 过 must follow the verb part directly.

items.q: 我去过三___北京，每次都住在朋友家。
items.zh: 我去过三次北京，每次都住在朋友家。
items.py: wǒ qù guo sān cì běi jīng měi cì dōu zhù zài péng you jiā
items.en: I've been to Beijing three times, and each time I stayed with a friend.
items.why: Going somewhere is counted in occasions: 三次. 遍 is for going through something from start to finish, and 个 and 下 are not the counters for trips.

items.q: 我还没去___那家新开的健身房，不知道好不好。
items.zh: 我还没去过那家新开的健身房，不知道好不好。
items.py: wǒ hái méi qù guo nà jiā xīn kāi de jiàn shēn fáng bù zhī dào hǎo bu hǎo
items.en: I haven't been to that newly opened gym yet, so I don't know if it's any good.
items.why: 还没…过 means 'have not yet been'. 过 stays after the verb, and 了 cannot appear after 没.

items.s: 这个游戏我玩过两遍，没有那么难。
items.s_py: zhè ge yóu xì wǒ wán guo liǎng biàn méi yǒu nà me nán
items.zh: 这个游戏我玩过两遍，没有那么难。
items.py: zhè ge yóu xì wǒ wán guo liǎng biàn méi yǒu nà me nán
items.en: I've played through this game twice, and it isn't that hard.
items.why: With the object fronted, the count follows 过: 玩过两遍. 遍 is right for playing a game through from start to finish.

items.zh: 这个动作我练过很多遍。
items.py: zhè ge dòng zuò wǒ liàn guo hěn duō biàn
items.en: I have practised this move many times.
items.why: With the object fronted, the count follows 过 directly: 练过很多遍. 遍 fits repeating a whole move from start to finish.

items.q: 这个月的会员费我交___了，你不用再交了。
items.zh: 这个月的会员费我交过了，你不用再交了。
items.py: zhè ge yuè de huì yuán fèi wǒ jiāo guo le nǐ bù yòng zài jiāo le
items.en: I've already paid this month's membership fee, so you don't need to pay again.
items.why: 交过了 reports that the routine payment is already done. 着 would mean I am paying right now, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

items.zh: 这首歌我听过很多遍。
items.py: zhè shǒu gē wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn
items.en: I've listened to this song many times.
items.why: With a fronted topic the count follows 过 directly: 听过很多遍. A song heard from start to finish is counted with 遍.

items.s_py: wǒ méi mǎi guo le nà shuāng qiú xié
items.zh: 我没买过那双球鞋。
items.py: wǒ méi mǎi guo nà shuāng qiú xié
items.en: I have never bought that pair of sneakers.
items.why: 了 cannot follow 没 or 没…过. Experience is negated with 没…过 alone.

items.s: 你有没有试过这种运动鞋？
items.s_py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shì guo zhè zhǒng yùn dòng xié
items.zh: 你有没有试过这种运动鞋？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shì guo zhè zhǒng yùn dòng xié
items.en: Have you ever tried this kind of sports shoe?
items.why: 有没有 + verb + 过 is a complete experience question. No 吗 and no 了 are added.

items.zh: 药我已经吃过了。
items.py: yào wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le
items.en: I've already taken the medicine.
items.why: 已经 sits before the verb 吃过 and 了 closes the sentence. The object either goes between 过 and 了 or is fronted as the topic.

items.s: 他的球拍丢过，现在正在到处找。
items.s_py: tā de qiú pāi diū guo xiàn zài zhèng zài dào chù zhǎo
items.zh: 他的球拍丢了，现在正在到处找。
items.py: tā de qiú pāi diū le xiàn zài zhèng zài dào chù zhǎo
items.en: His racket is lost, and he is looking for it everywhere right now.
items.why: He is looking for it now, so the loss is a fresh event with a lasting result: 了. 丢过 says it was lost at some time before.

items.zh: 我没去过那家店。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā diàn
items.en: I have never been to that shop.
items.why: 没 goes before the verb and 过 stays on it: 没去过. 不 and 了 are not used, and the object may be fronted as the topic.

items.q: 他曾经学___吉他，可是一首歌也没学会。
items.zh: 他曾经学过吉他，可是一首歌也没学会。
items.py: tā céng jīng xué guo jí tā kě shì yī shǒu gē yě méi xué huì
items.en: He once took guitar lessons, but he never learned a single song.
items.why: 曾经 and the outcome 没学会 mark learning the guitar as a past experience: 学过. 了 does not combine with 曾经, and 着 would mean he is still studying.

items.q: 这么多年了，我还___去过那个小岛，一直想去看看。
items.zh: 这么多年了，我还没去过那个小岛，一直想去看看。
items.py: zhè me duō nián le wǒ hái méi qù guo nà ge xiǎo dǎo yī zhí xiǎng qù kàn kan
items.en: After all these years I still haven't been to that little island, and I've always wanted to go.
items.why: 还没去过 = still not been. 不 cannot be used with 过, and 别 is only for orders.

items.s: 他去过北京，下个月才回来。
items.s_py: tā qù guo běi jīng xià ge yuè cái huí lái
items.zh: 他去了北京，下个月才回来。
items.py: tā qù le běi jīng xià ge yuè cái huí lái
items.en: He has gone to Beijing and won't be back until next month.
items.why: 下个月才回来 means he is still away, so 了 is needed. 过 would mean he has already been and returned.

items.q: 我在这家店见过___两次___。
items.zh: 我在这家店见过他两次。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè jiā diàn jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
items.en: I have seen him in this shop twice.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 见过他两次. 见过两次他 is a classic mistake, since only ordinary nouns and place names can follow the count.

items.q: 这条路我以前走___，前面有个很大的坡，骑车要小心。
items.zh: 这条路我以前走过，前面有个很大的坡，骑车要小心。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù wǒ yǐ qián zǒu guo qián miàn yǒu gè hěn dà de pō qí chē yào xiǎo xīn
items.en: I've walked this road before; there's a big slope ahead, so be careful if you cycle.
items.why: 以前 and the warning about the slope show the speaker knows the road from earlier experience: 过. 着 would mean they are walking it now.

items.q: 他在这个游泳馆教___孩子们游泳___，现在换了地方。
items.zh: 他在这个游泳馆教过孩子们游泳，现在换了地方。
items.py: tā zài zhè ge yóu yǒng guǎn jiāo guo hái zi men yóu yǒng xiàn zài huàn le dì fang
items.en: He once taught children to swim at this swimming pool; now he has moved somewhere else.
items.why: 过 belongs to 教, the main verb, so it comes right after it, before 孩子们游泳. At the very end (游泳过) it would attach to nothing.

items.zh: 你去过那家商店没有？
items.py: nǐ qù guo nà jiā shāng diàn méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever been to that shop?
items.why: The experience question ends with 没有, and 过 stays on 去. 不 cannot be used here.

items.q: 我以前在这个球场工作___，对这里很熟。
items.zh: 我以前在这个球场工作过，对这里很熟。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài zhè ge qiú chǎng gōng zuò guo duì zhè lǐ hěn shú
items.en: I used to work at this sports ground, so I know it well.
items.why: 以前 and 对这里很熟 present the job as past experience: 工作过. 着 would mean I am working there now, and a bare 了 would leave 工作 unfinished without a length of time.

items.s: 我从来不买过这么贵的东西。
items.s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù mǎi guo zhè me guì de dōng xi
items.zh: 我从来没买过这么贵的东西。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi mǎi guo zhè me guì de dōng xi
items.en: I have never bought anything this expensive.
items.why: With 过 the negative must be 没. 从来不 exists only for habits and takes no 过.

items.q: 你去过那个球场___？
items.zh: 你去过那个球场吗？
items.py: nǐ qù guo nà ge qiú chǎng ma
items.en: Have you been to that sports ground?
items.why: A yes/no experience question ends with 吗. 不 cannot be used with 过, and 的 and 呢 do not form this question.

items.zh: 他从来没在这个球场打过球。
items.py: tā cóng lái méi zài zhè ge qiú chǎng dǎ guo qiú
items.en: He has never played ball at this ground.
items.why: 从来没 comes before the place phrase and 过 stays on 打. The place phrase can also move in front of 从来 or the subject, but 过 never leaves the verb.

items.zh: 我找过她三次。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo guo tā sān cì
items.en: I have gone looking for her three times.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 找过她三次. 找过三次她 is the classic error.

items.q: 昨天晚上我们先吃饭，然后看___一场比赛。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我们先吃饭，然后看了一场比赛。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men xiān chī fàn rán hòu kàn le yī chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: Last night we had dinner first and then watched a match.
items.why: 先…然后 is a chain of events told in order, which takes 了. 过 would turn the match into a life experience, which does not fit the story.

items.s_py: wǒ méi yǒu kàn guo zhè ge jié mù
items.zh: 我没有看过这个节目。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu kàn guo zhè ge jié mù
items.en: I haven't seen this programme.
items.why: 没有 + verb + 过 is correct: the negative of 过 is 没 or 没有, and 过 stays.

items.q: 我已经吃___饭了，你们不用等我。
items.zh: 我已经吃过饭了，你们不用等我。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo fàn le nǐ men bù yòng děng wǒ
items.en: I've already eaten, so you don't need to wait for me.
items.why: 吃过饭了 says the meal is already done, with the object between 过 and 了. 着 would mean I am eating right now.

items.q: 我来过这个商场___，但是没买过东西。
items.zh: 我来过这个商场几次，但是没买过东西。
items.py: wǒ lái guo zhè ge shāng chǎng jǐ cì dàn shì méi mǎi guo dōng xi
items.en: I've been to this mall a few times, but I have never bought anything.
items.why: Visits are counted with 次: 几次. 遍 is for whole run-throughs of a book, film or song, and 个 and 下 do not count visits.

items.zh: 我还没去过长城。
items.py: wǒ hái méi qù guo cháng chéng
items.en: I haven't been to the Great Wall yet.
items.why: 还 comes before 没 and 过 stays on the verb: 还没去过. 还 cannot go after 没.

items.task: Make it negative: he has never had them.
items.zh: 他没有吃过饺子。
items.py: tā méi yǒu chī guo jiǎo zi
items.en: He has never eaten dumplings.
items.why: 没有 goes before the verb and 过 stays: 没有吃过. Dropping 过 would give 'he did not eat them', a single occasion.

items.s_py: wǒ bù qù guo nà jiā shāng diàn
items.zh: 我没去过那家商店。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā shāng diàn
items.en: I have never been to that shop.
items.why: 过 is negated with 没, not 不. 不去过 does not exist.

items.q: 你去商店看___那件外套了吗？价钱怎么样？
items.zh: 你去商店看过那件外套了吗？价钱怎么样？
items.py: nǐ qù shāng diàn kàn guo nà jiàn wài tào le ma jià qian zěn me yàng
items.en: Did you go to the shop and have a look at that coat? How much was it?
items.why: 看过…了吗 asks 'have you already done it?' about an expected errand. 着 would ask whether you are looking at it now.

items.q: 我从来没见___这么大的体育馆，里面能坐好几万人。
items.zh: 我从来没见过这么大的体育馆，里面能坐好几万人。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me dà de tǐ yù guǎn lǐ miàn néng zuò hǎo jǐ wàn rén
items.en: I have never seen such a big stadium; tens of thousands of people could sit in it.
items.why: 从来没见过这么…的… 'never seen such a …' keeps 过. 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 is not an experience marker.

items.q: 这个故事我听过很多___，已经会讲了。
items.zh: 这个故事我听过很多遍，已经会讲了。
items.py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn yǐ jīng huì jiǎng le
items.en: I have heard this story many times and can tell it myself by now.
items.why: 听 a story all the way through is counted with 遍. 个, 下 and 位 are not counters for hearing something again and again.

items.q: “你吃药了吗？”“还没___呢。”
items.zh: “你吃药了吗？”“还没吃呢。”
items.py: nǐ chī yào le ma hái méi chī ne
items.en: "Have you taken your medicine?" "Not yet."
items.why: The negative of 'already done' is 还没 + verb (+ 呢). 了 cannot follow 没, and 吃过了 is the positive 'already eaten'.

items.task: Say you have already eaten lunch (use 过).
items.zh: 我吃过午饭了。
items.py: wǒ chī guo wǔ fàn le
items.en: I've already had lunch.
items.why: V过了 says a routine thing is already done: 过 right after the verb and 了 at the end, with the object between them or fronted.

items.q: 她还没有买___这么贵的东西，所以有点不敢。
items.zh: 她还没有买过这么贵的东西，所以有点不敢。
items.py: tā hái méi yǒu mǎi guo zhè me guì de dōng xi suǒ yǐ yǒu diǎn bù gǎn
items.en: She has never bought anything this expensive, so she is a bit nervous about it.
items.why: 'Never bought such a thing' is 没有买过 with 过 kept. 了 cannot follow 没有, and 着 would not give a meaning of experience.

items.s: 他去年在这个球场打过一次比赛。
items.s_py: tā qù nián zài zhè ge qiú chǎng dǎ guo yī cì bǐ sài
items.zh: 他去年在这个球场打过一次比赛。
items.py: tā qù nián zài zhè ge qiú chǎng dǎ guo yī cì bǐ sài
items.en: Last year he played a match once at this ground.
items.why: 过 plus a count is fine even with a past time word like 去年: it says there was one such occasion, and the object follows the count.

items.q: 她在这个球场参加过两___比赛，今年想再来一次。
items.zh: 她在这个球场参加过两次比赛，今年想再来一次。
items.py: tā zài zhè ge qiú chǎng cān jiā guo liǎng cì bǐ sài jīn nián xiǎng zài lái yī cì
items.en: She has taken part in competitions at this ground twice, and wants to come again this year.
items.why: Taking part in competitions is counted in occasions: 两次. 遍 would mean going through one event from start to end, which does not fit 参加.

items.q: 我___有看过这场比赛，不知道谁赢了。
items.zh: 我没有看过这场比赛，不知道谁赢了。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu kàn guo zhè chǎng bǐ sài bù zhī dào shéi yíng le
items.en: I haven't seen this match, so I don't know who won.
items.why: 没有 + 过 is the negative of experience: 没有看过. 不有 does not exist, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 这种牌子的运动鞋我以前穿___，很舒服，这次还想买。
items.zh: 这种牌子的运动鞋我以前穿过，很舒服，这次还想买。
items.py: zhè zhǒng pái zi de yùn dòng xié wǒ yǐ qián chuān guo hěn shū fu zhè cì hái xiǎng mǎi
items.en: I've worn this brand of sports shoes before. They were comfortable, and I want to buy them again.
items.why: 穿过 says I have the experience of wearing them, which is why I want them again. 着 would mean I am wearing them now, and 得 and 地 are other particles that cannot follow a verb here.

items.s: 我还没吃过了，你们先吃吧。
items.s_py: wǒ hái méi chī guo le nǐ men xiān chī ba
items.zh: 我还没吃呢，你们先吃吧。
items.py: wǒ hái méi chī ne nǐ men xiān chī ba
items.en: I haven't eaten yet, so go ahead and eat.
items.why: 'Not yet' is 还没 + verb (+ 呢). 吃过了 means 'already eaten' and cannot follow 没.

items.s_py: wǒ chī guo le nǐ men chī ba
items.zh: 我吃过了，你们吃吧。
items.py: wǒ chī guo le nǐ men chī ba
items.en: I've already eaten; you go ahead.
items.why: V过了 is a normal way to say a routine thing is already done, such as a meal. It is not about life experience.

items.s: 我从来不吃甜的东西，所以从来没买过蛋糕。
items.s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù chī tián de dōng xi suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi mǎi guo dàn gāo
items.zh: 我从来不吃甜的东西，所以从来没买过蛋糕。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù chī tián de dōng xi suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi mǎi guo dàn gāo
items.en: I never eat sweet things, so I have never bought a cake.
items.why: 从来不 states a habit and takes no 过, while 从来没…过 covers your whole past. Both are correct here.

items.task: Say he has gone to Shanghai (a recent event, not an experience).
items.zh: 他去了上海。
items.py: tā qù le shàng hǎi
items.en: He has gone to Shanghai.
items.why: Reporting a completed trip whose result still holds takes 了 right after the verb. 过 would only say he has been there at some time.

items.q: 我的钱包丢___，现在正在到处找。
items.zh: 我的钱包丢了，现在正在到处找。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo diū le xiàn zài zhèng zài dào chù zhǎo
items.en: I've lost my wallet and am looking for it everywhere right now.
items.why: The wallet is still missing, so the loss is a fresh event with a lasting result: 了. 丢过 would say it has been lost at some point before.

items.q: 我没打___网球，想先学学再打。
items.zh: 我没打过网球，想先学学再打。
items.py: wǒ méi dǎ guo wǎng qiú xiǎng xiān xué xue zài dǎ
items.en: I have never played tennis, so I want to learn first.
items.why: After 没 the experience marker 过 stays: 没打过 = have never played. 了 never follows 没, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

items.src_py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng
items.task: Turn it into a 吗 question.
items.zh: 你看过这个电影吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng ma
items.en: Have you seen this film?
items.why: 吗 closes the question and 过 stays on the verb. Do not also add 不 or 没有 to the same question.

items.s_py: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū méi yǒu ma
items.zh: 你看过这本书吗？
items.py: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū ma
items.en: Have you read this book?
items.why: Use one question marker only: 吗 or 没有. Stacking 没有 and 吗 is not Chinese.

items.q: 我从来没试___在网上买衣服，不知道合不合适。
items.zh: 我从来没试过在网上买衣服，不知道合不合适。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi shì guo zài wǎng shàng mǎi yī fu bù zhī dào hé bu hé shì
items.en: I have never tried buying clothes online, so I don't know whether they would fit.
items.why: 从来没试过 = never once tried. 过 stays after 试, and 了 cannot appear after 没.

items.task: Make it negative: you have never been.
items.zh: 我没去过上海。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi
items.en: I have never been to Shanghai.
items.why: The negative of experience is 没 + verb + 过. 不 is not used with 过, and 了 never follows 没.

items.s: 你去不去过那家健身房？
items.s_py: nǐ qù bu qù guo nà jiā jiàn shēn fáng
items.zh: 你去没去过那家健身房？
items.py: nǐ qù méi qù guo nà jiā jiàn shēn fáng
items.en: Have you ever been to that gym?
items.why: The A-not-A form of 去过 is built on 没, because 过 is only ever negated with 没. 不 is wrong here.

items.q: 他先给我们看___他的新球拍，然后又带我们去了球场。
items.zh: 他先给我们看了他的新球拍，然后又带我们去了球场。
items.py: tā xiān gěi wǒ men kàn le tā de xīn qiú pāi rán hòu yòu dài wǒ men qù le qiú chǎng
items.en: He first showed us his new racket and then took us to the court.
items.why: 先…然后…又 narrates events in sequence, so each verb takes 了. 过 would make the showing a life experience, which makes no sense in a chain of events.

items.q: 我们在球场见___面___。
items.zh: 我们在球场见过面。
items.py: wǒ men zài qiú chǎng jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We have met at the court before.
items.why: 见面 is a verb plus object (见 + 面), so 过 goes between them: 见过面. Putting it at the end (见面过) is not possible.

items.q: 他是个很自律的人，从来___吃过夜宵，也从来不熬夜。
items.zh: 他是个很自律的人，从来没吃过夜宵，也从来不熬夜。
items.py: tā shì gè hěn zì lǜ de rén cóng lái méi chī guo yè xiāo yě cóng lái bù áo yè
items.en: He is a very disciplined person: he has never eaten a late-night snack and never stays up late.
items.why: With 过 the negative must be 没: 从来没吃过. 从来不吃过 is impossible, since 不 is for habits and takes no 过, as in the second half (从来不熬夜).

items.zh: 我买过这种球拍。
items.py: wǒ mǎi guo zhè zhǒng qiú pāi
items.en: I have bought this kind of racket before.
items.why: 过 sits straight after the verb 买: 买过. The object comes after it, or the whole object can be fronted as a topic.

items.q: 他结___婚___，有一个女儿。
items.zh: 他结过婚，有一个女儿。
items.py: tā jié guo hūn yǒu yī ge nǚ ér
items.en: He has been married and has a daughter.
items.why: 结婚 splits into 结 + 婚 and 过 goes after 结: 结过婚. 结婚过 puts 过 after the whole word, which Chinese does not allow.

items.q: 她曾经在大学里打___排球，现在只是偶尔打打。
items.zh: 她曾经在大学里打过排球，现在只是偶尔打打。
items.py: tā céng jīng zài dà xué lǐ dǎ guo pái qiú xiàn zài zhǐ shì ǒu ěr dǎ da
items.en: She once played volleyball at university; now she only plays occasionally.
items.why: 曾经 plus a contrast with now calls for experience 过. 着 would say she is playing at this moment, and 了 does not combine with 曾经.

items.q: 她买___那件外套，现在正穿着呢。
items.zh: 她买了那件外套，现在正穿着呢。
items.py: tā mǎi le nà jiàn wài tào xiàn zài zhèng chuān zhe ne
items.en: She has bought that coat and is wearing it right now.
items.why: The purchase has a result that holds now (she has the coat on): 了. 过 would mean the buying is a finished experience with no link to the present.

items.zh: 你有没有看过这场比赛？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn guo zhè chǎng bǐ sài
items.en: Have you ever seen this match?
items.why: 有没有 goes right before 看过, and the question takes no 吗. The object may be fronted as a topic.

items.q: 我外婆以前做___售货员，后来才开了自己的小店。
items.zh: 我外婆以前做过售货员，后来才开了自己的小店。
items.py: wǒ wài pó yǐ qián zuò guo shòu huò yuán hòu lái cái kāi le zì jǐ de xiǎo diàn
items.en: My grandmother used to work as a shop assistant before she opened her own little shop.
items.why: 以前 plus a later change in her life makes the job a past experience: 做过. 着 would mean she still does it, and 了 with a bare job title does not describe a past stage.

items.src_py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo
items.task: Say you have read it three times.
items.zh: 这本书我看过三遍。
items.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo sān biàn
items.en: I have read this book three times.
items.why: The count follows 过: 看过三遍. 遍 fits reading a book through from start to finish.

items.q: 你吃过那家店的蛋糕___？
items.zh: 你吃过那家店的蛋糕没有？
items.py: nǐ chī guo nà jiā diàn de dàn gāo méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever tried the cakes from that shop?
items.why: The tag question for experience is 没有: …过…没有？. Using 不 contradicts the 没 that negates 过, and 不是 and 不吃 do not ask about experience.

items.q: 我去那家餐厅吃___饭___，菜做得很地道。
items.zh: 我去那家餐厅吃过饭，菜做得很地道。
items.py: wǒ qù nà jiā cān tīng chī guo fàn cài zuò de hěn dì dao
items.en: I have eaten at that restaurant, and the food is authentic.
items.why: With 去 + place before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb 吃 and before its object 饭. 吃饭过 leaves 过 after the object.

items.zh: 她在国家队打过排球。
items.py: tā zài guó jiā duì dǎ guo pái qiú
items.en: She has played volleyball on the national team.
items.why: The place phrase 在国家队 goes before the verb and 过 sits right after 打, before its object 排球.

items.q: 我在公园里打___太极拳___。
items.zh: 我在公园里打过太极拳。
items.py: wǒ zài gōng yuán lǐ dǎ guo tài jí quán
items.en: I have done tai chi in the park.
items.why: 过 attaches to the verb 打, before the object 太极拳. After the object it would be left without a verb to belong to.

items.q: 他年轻的时候曾经参加___马拉松比赛，所以现在很会控制速度。
items.zh: 他年轻的时候曾经参加过马拉松比赛，所以现在很会控制速度。
items.py: tā nián qīng de shí hou céng jīng cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng bǐ sài suǒ yǐ xiàn zài hěn huì kòng zhì sù dù
items.en: When he was young he once took part in marathons, so he is good at pacing himself now.
items.why: The earlier experience explains his present skill, so 参加过. 曾经 rules out 了, and 着 would mean he is taking part right now.

items.s_py: wǒ qù sān cì guo nà ge gōng yuán
items.zh: 我去过三次那个公园。
items.py: wǒ qù guo sān cì nà ge gōng yuán
items.en: I have been to that park three times.
items.why: 过 sticks to the verb, and the count follows it. The count cannot come before 过.

items.q: 我从来没买___这么贵的球拍。
items.zh: 我从来没买过这么贵的球拍。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi mǎi guo zhè me guì de qiú pāi
items.en: I have never bought such an expensive racket.
items.why: 从来没…过 means 'never once'. 过 must stay, and 了 cannot follow 没.

items.q: 你说的那个球星，我没听___。
items.zh: 你说的那个球星，我没听过。
items.py: nǐ shuō de nà ge qiú xīng wǒ méi tīng guo
items.en: I have never heard of that football star you mentioned.
items.why: 没听过 says 'I have never heard of him'. 了 never follows 没, and 得 and 的 do not mark experience.

items.q: 球赛的重播我已经看___了，结果我都知道了。
items.zh: 球赛的重播我已经看过了，结果我都知道了。
items.py: qiú sài de chóng bō wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guo le jié guǒ wǒ dōu zhī dào le
items.en: I've already watched the replay of the match, so I know the result.
items.why: 看过…了 = already done, with the topic fronted. 着 would mean I am watching it now, which contradicts knowing the result.

items.q: 我以前在海南住___，那里冬天也很热。
items.zh: 我以前在海南住过，那里冬天也很热。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài hǎi nán zhù guo nà lǐ dōng tiān yě hěn rè
items.en: I used to live in Hainan; it's hot there even in winter.
items.why: 以前 plus a place I know first-hand is an experience that is over: 过. 着 would mean I still live there, and 住了 would need a length of time or a result to be complete.

items.q: 这种雨衣我穿___，一点儿也不防水。
items.zh: 这种雨衣我穿过，一点儿也不防水。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yǔ yī wǒ chuān guo yī diǎn r yě bù fáng shuǐ
items.en: I've worn this kind of raincoat; it isn't waterproof at all.
items.why: "I have tried it, so I know" is experience, and 过 sits right after the verb. 着 would describe wearing it right now, which cannot support a verdict from past use.

items.q: 他以前开___出租车，现在在银行工作。
items.zh: 他以前开过出租车，现在在银行工作。
items.py: tā yǐ qián kāi guo chū zū chē xiàn zài zài yín háng gōng zuò
items.en: He used to drive a taxi; now he works at a bank.
items.why: A job he did before and no longer does is experience: 开过. 着 would mean he is driving now, which clashes with 现在在银行工作.

items.q: 这种天气预报软件我以前用___，后来发现不太准，就不用了。
items.zh: 这种天气预报软件我以前用过，后来发现不太准，就不用了。
items.py: zhè zhǒng tiān qì yù bào ruǎn jiàn wǒ yǐ qián yòng guo hòu lái fā xiàn bù tài zhǔn jiù bù yòng le
items.en: I used to use this kind of weather app, but I found it not very accurate and stopped.
items.why: 以前…后来… describes a stretch of use that is finished, so 过 after 用. 着 would mean I am still using it, which the last clause denies.

items.q: 同学说小李以前当___班长，所以很会管人。
items.zh: 同学说小李以前当过班长，所以很会管人。
items.py: tóng xué shuō xiǎo lǐ yǐ qián dāng guo bān zhǎng suǒ yǐ hěn huì guǎn rén
items.en: A classmate says Xiao Li used to be class monitor, so he is good at managing people.
items.why: 以前 plus a role he no longer holds is experience: 当过. 当着 would mean he is monitor now, which 以前 rules out.

items.q: 下这么大的雨我也遇到___，别担心。
items.zh: 下这么大的雨我也遇到过，别担心。
items.py: xià zhè me dà de yǔ wǒ yě yù dào guo bié dān xīn
items.en: I've been through rain this heavy too, so don't worry.
items.why: "I have been through it, so do not worry" is experience: 遇到过. 着 would mean running into it right now, which would not reassure anyone.

items.q: 小时候我们在这条河里游___泳，现在河水太脏了。
items.zh: 小时候我们在这条河里游过泳，现在河水太脏了。
items.py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ men zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóu guo yǒng xiàn zài hé shuǐ tài zāng le
items.en: As children we swam in this river; now the water is too dirty.
items.why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 游过泳. 小时候 with a contrast to now marks a finished past experience, which 了 or 着 would not give.

items.q: 我和小王以前见___面，所以一眼就认出他了。
items.zh: 我和小王以前见过面，所以一眼就认出他了。
items.py: wǒ hé xiǎo wáng yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn suǒ yǐ yī yǎn jiù rèn chū tā le
items.en: Xiao Wang and I have met before, so I recognised him at a glance.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes after 见. Having met before explains the recognition; 着 would mean the meeting is going on now.

items.q: 我以前去那儿吃___饭，菜很好吃，就是有点儿贵。
items.zh: 我以前去那儿吃过饭，菜很好吃，就是有点儿贵。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián qù nà r chī guo fàn cài hěn hǎo chī jiù shì yǒu diǎn r guì
items.en: I've eaten there before; the food is good, just a bit pricey.
items.why: With 去那儿 before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb 吃: 吃过饭. 了 would report a single meal and could not support a general verdict on the restaurant.

items.q: 我们以前在大雨里跑___步，那种感觉很特别。
items.zh: 我们以前在大雨里跑过步，那种感觉很特别。
items.py: wǒ men yǐ qián zài dà yǔ lǐ pǎo guo bù nà zhǒng gǎn jué hěn tè bié
items.en: We once ran in heavy rain; it felt special.
items.why: 跑步 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 跑过步. 以前 plus a remembered feeling is experience; 着 would describe running in progress.

items.q: 我以前在山上看___雪，太美了，我还想再看一次。
items.zh: 我以前在山上看过雪，太美了，我还想再看一次。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián zài shān shàng kàn guo xuě tài měi le wǒ hái xiǎng zài kàn yī cì
items.en: I have seen snow in the mountains before; it was so beautiful that I want to see it again.
items.why: 过 goes right after 看, before the object 雪. 还想再看 shows a past experience the speaker wants to repeat; 着 would mean looking at snow right now.

items.q: 我在国外留___学，所以不怕一个人生活。
items.zh: 我在国外留过学，所以不怕一个人生活。
items.py: wǒ zài guó wài liú guo xué suǒ yǐ bù pà yī ge rén shēng huó
items.en: I have studied abroad, so I'm not afraid of living alone.
items.why: 留学 is verb + object, so 过 goes in the middle: 留过学. The period abroad is over and explains the confidence; 着 would mean I am still studying abroad.

items.q: 我还没看___雪呢，真想去北方。
items.zh: 我还没看过雪呢，真想去北方。
items.py: wǒ hái méi kàn guo xuě ne zhēn xiǎng qù běi fāng
items.en: I haven't seen snow yet; I really want to go north.
items.why: 还没 + verb + 过 means "have not yet experienced it". 了 can never follow 没 here, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

items.q: 我___去过哈尔滨，不知道那里多冷。
items.zh: 我没去过哈尔滨，不知道那里多冷。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo hā ěr bīn bù zhī dào nà lǐ duō lěng
items.en: I've never been to Harbin, so I don't know how cold it gets.
items.why: The negative of 过 is 没: 没去过. 不去过 does not exist, and 别 is a command.

items.q: 我们俩还没一起旅行___，周末先去爬山吧。
items.zh: 我们俩还没一起旅行过，周末先去爬山吧。
items.py: wǒ men liǎ hái méi yī qǐ lǚ xíng guo zhōu mò xiān qù pá shān ba
items.en: The two of us haven't travelled together yet, so let's start with a hike this weekend.
items.why: 还没…过 says the experience has not happened yet. 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 does not fit "never done".

items.q: 朋友说这家店不错，可惜我一直没去___。
items.zh: 朋友说这家店不错，可惜我一直没去过。
items.py: péng you shuō zhè jiā diàn bù cuò kě xī wǒ yī zhí méi qù guo
items.en: A friend says this shop is good; too bad I've never been.
items.why: 一直没 + verb + 过 means "never so far". 没去了 is impossible, and 没去着 would mean trying to go and failing once.

items.q: 我没有参加___他们的聚会，不知道谁会来。
items.zh: 我没有参加过他们的聚会，不知道谁会来。
items.py: wǒ méi yǒu cān jiā guo tā men de jù huì bù zhī dào shéi huì lái
items.en: I've never been to any of their gatherings, so I don't know who comes.
items.why: 没有 + verb + 过 says "never so far". 了 cannot follow 没有, and 着 does not suit a one-off event.

items.q: 因为天气一直不好，我们到现在还没去___那个湖。
items.zh: 因为天气一直不好，我们到现在还没去过那个湖。
items.py: yīn wèi tiān qì yī zhí bù hǎo wǒ men dào xiàn zài hái méi qù guo nà ge hú
items.en: Because the weather has stayed bad, we still haven't been to that lake.
items.why: 到现在还没 asks for "not yet, ever": 没去过. 了 after 没 is ungrammatical, and 着 would not mean "not yet been".

items.q: 我从小怕冷，没有滑___雪，也没有溜过冰。
items.zh: 我从小怕冷，没有滑过雪，也没有溜过冰。
items.py: wǒ cóng xiǎo pà lěng méi yǒu huá guo xuě yě méi yǒu liū guo bīng
items.en: I've feared the cold since childhood, so I've never skied or skated.
items.why: Two parallel negatives: 没有 + verb + 过 for "never". 了 and 着 cannot follow 没有 in this meaning.

items.q: 他现在不在家，他去___上海。
items.zh: 他现在不在家，他去了上海。
items.py: tā xiàn zài bù zài jiā tā qù le shàng hǎi
items.en: He is not home now; he has gone to Shanghai.
items.why: He left and is still away, so the trip is a completed event whose result holds now: 了. 过 would mean he went and has already come back.

items.q: 小王昨天搬___家，今天很累。
items.zh: 小王昨天搬了家，今天很累。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān bān le jiā jīn tiān hěn lèi
items.en: Xiao Wang moved house yesterday and is tired today.
items.why: 昨天 plus a result that still holds today (tired) is one specific event: 了. 过 would mean he has moved house at some time in his life.

items.q: 我小时候去___上海，所以知道那里的冬天很冷。
items.zh: 我小时候去过上海，所以知道那里的冬天很冷。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou qù guo shàng hǎi suǒ yǐ zhī dào nà lǐ de dōng tiān hěn lěng
items.en: I went to Shanghai as a child, so I know its winters are cold.
items.why: 小时候 plus "so I know" cites what a past trip taught me: 过. 了 would only report one trip, and 着 does not fit a trip.

items.q: 昨天雪很大，我们堆___三个雪人。
items.zh: 昨天雪很大，我们堆了三个雪人。
items.py: zuó tiān xuě hěn dà wǒ men duī le sān ge xuě rén
items.en: It snowed hard yesterday and we built three snowmen.
items.why: 昨天 plus a counted object is one specific event: 了 right after the verb. 过 would mean "have built three before", which does not fit a stated day.

items.q: 她上星期买___一把新雨伞，还没用过呢。
items.zh: 她上星期买了一把新雨伞，还没用过呢。
items.py: tā shàng xīng qī mǎi le yī bǎ xīn yǔ sǎn hái méi yòng guo ne
items.en: She bought a new umbrella last week and hasn't used it yet.
items.why: 上星期 plus a counted object is one specific purchase: 了. 过 would say she has bought umbrellas in general, not this one.

items.q: 这家店我以前来___，所以知道哪个菜好吃。
items.zh: 这家店我以前来过，所以知道哪个菜好吃。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn wǒ yǐ qián lái guo suǒ yǐ zhī dào nǎ ge cài hǎo chī
items.en: I've been to this restaurant before, so I know which dishes are good.
items.why: 以前来 plus "so I know" cites what experience taught me: 过. 了 would only report one visit and could not explain the knowledge.

items.q: 昨天晚上我们看___一场电影，十一点才回家。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我们看了一场电影，十一点才回家。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men kàn le yī chǎng diàn yǐng shí yī diǎn cái huí jiā
items.en: Last night we saw a film and didn't get home until eleven.
items.why: 昨天晚上 plus a counted object and a time of return narrates one event: 了. 过 would mean "have seen a film before", which cannot tell what happened last night.

items.q: 听说小王和小李昨天终于见___面，还一起吃了晚饭。
items.zh: 听说小王和小李昨天终于见了面，还一起吃了晚饭。
items.py: tīng shuō xiǎo wáng hé xiǎo lǐ zuó tiān zhōng yú jiàn le miàn hái yī qǐ chī le wǎn fàn
items.en: I hear Xiao Wang and Xiao Li finally met yesterday and had dinner together.
items.why: 昨天 plus 终于 and a chain of events (met, then ate) is narration, so 了 goes after 见. 过 says "have met before", which clashes with 终于 and 昨天.

items.q: 他昨天遇到___一场大雪，路上走了三个小时。
items.zh: 他昨天遇到了一场大雪，路上走了三个小时。
items.py: tā zuó tiān yù dào le yī chǎng dà xuě lù shàng zǒu le sān ge xiǎo shí
items.en: Yesterday he ran into a heavy snowfall and spent three hours on the road.
items.why: 昨天 and "took three hours" tell what happened on one day: 了. 过 would say he has experienced heavy snow at some time, and cannot carry the consequence.

items.q: 这个季节的杭州我以前去___，雨多，人也多，这次想换个地方。
items.zh: 这个季节的杭州我以前去过，雨多，人也多，这次想换个地方。
items.py: zhè ge jì jié de háng zhōu wǒ yǐ qián qù guo yǔ duō rén yě duō zhè cì xiǎng huàn ge dì fang
items.en: I've been to Hangzhou at this time of year before: lots of rain and lots of people, so this time I want somewhere else.
items.why: A fronted topic, 以前 and a verdict drawn from what I know: 去过. 了 would report one completed trip and would not justify choosing elsewhere.

items.q: 我去过两___北京，冬天的北京特别冷。
items.zh: 我去过两次北京，冬天的北京特别冷。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng dōng tiān de běi jīng tè bié lěng
items.en: I've been to Beijing twice; Beijing in winter is especially cold.
items.why: 次 counts occasions of going. 遍 means a whole run-through (reading, watching), and 个 is not the counter for trips.

items.q: 我见过他三___，每次都是下雨天。
items.zh: 我见过他三次，每次都是下雨天。
items.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā sān cì měi cì dōu shì xià yǔ tiān
items.en: I've met him three times, and it was a rainy day every time.
items.why: 次 counts meetings, and the pronoun 他 comes before the count. 遍 is for going through something from start to finish, not for meeting a person.

items.q: 这个星期我找过他___，他都不在。
items.zh: 这个星期我找过他三次，他都不在。
items.py: zhè ge xīng qī wǒ zhǎo guo tā sān cì tā dōu bù zài
items.en: I looked for him three times this week and he was out each time.
items.why: 次 counts occasions of looking for someone, and a pronoun object goes before the count. 遍 is for full run-throughs, and 个 and 点 are not counters for attempts.

items.q: 老师说过很多___，可是我还是记不住。
items.zh: 老师说过很多遍，可是我还是记不住。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō guo hěn duō biàn kě shì wǒ hái shì jì bù zhù
items.en: The teacher has said it many times, but I still cannot remember.
items.why: 遍 counts repetitions of saying something through; 个, 年 and 把 do not count repetitions of speaking.

items.q: 你去过几___北京？
items.zh: 你去过几次北京？
items.py: nǐ qù guo jǐ cì běi jīng
items.en: How many times have you been to Beijing?
items.why: 几次 asks how many occasions. 遍 is for whole run-throughs, and 个 and 年 do not count visits.

items.q: 这个故事奶奶给我讲过无数___，我都能背下来了。
items.zh: 这个故事奶奶给我讲过无数遍，我都能背下来了。
items.py: zhè ge gù shi nǎi nai gěi wǒ jiǎng guo wú shù biàn wǒ dōu néng bèi xià lái le
items.en: Grandma has told me this story countless times; I can recite it.
items.why: 遍 fits telling a story through from start to finish. 个, 年 and 本 are not counters for repetitions.

items.q: 这个地方我们下雨天来过___，所以路很熟。
items.zh: 这个地方我们下雨天来过很多次，所以路很熟。
items.py: zhè ge dì fang wǒ men xià yǔ tiān lái guo hěn duō cì suǒ yǐ lù hěn shú
items.en: We've come to this place on rainy days many times, so we know the road well.
items.why: 次 counts occasions of coming. 遍 is for run-throughs of a text or film, and 个 and 步 do not count visits.

items.q: 你吃饭了吗？吃___了，谢谢。
items.zh: 你吃饭了吗？吃过了，谢谢。
items.py: nǐ chī fàn le ma chī guo le xiè xie
items.en: Have you eaten? Yes, I already have, thanks.
items.why: V过了 reports a routine thing as already done. 着 would mean you are eating at this moment, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

items.q: 你吃___药了吗？没吃的话现在就吃。
items.zh: 你吃过药了吗？没吃的话现在就吃。
items.py: nǐ chī guo yào le ma méi chī de huà xiàn zài jiù chī
items.en: Have you taken your medicine yet? If not, take it now.
items.why: Asking whether a routine thing is already done: 吃过药了吗. 着 would ask whether you are in the middle of taking it.

items.q: 晚上一起吃饭吗？不了，我已经吃___了。
items.zh: 晚上一起吃饭吗？不了，我已经吃过了。
items.py: wǎn shang yī qǐ chī fàn ma bù le wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le
items.en: Dinner together tonight? No thanks, I've already eaten.
items.why: 已经 + V过…了 says a routine thing is already done. 着 would mean "am eating right now", which does not decline the invitation.

items.q: 天气预报我已经看___了，明天不会下雨。
items.zh: 天气预报我已经看过了，明天不会下雨。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào wǒ yǐ jīng kàn guo le míng tiān bù huì xià yǔ
items.en: I've already checked the weather forecast; it won't rain tomorrow.
items.why: With the object fronted, 看过了 means "already checked". 着 would be "checking right now", which cannot report what the forecast says.

items.q: 你问___老师了吗？他说周末不会下雨。
items.zh: 你问过老师了吗？他说周末不会下雨。
items.py: nǐ wèn guo lǎo shī le ma tā shuō zhōu mò bù huì xià yǔ
items.en: Have you asked the teacher yet? He says it won't rain this weekend.
items.why: 问过…了吗 asks whether a to-do is already done. 着 would mean asking in progress, and 的 and 得 are not aspect markers.

items.q: 你检查___行李了吗？___检查呢，等一下。
items.zh: 你检查过行李了吗？还没检查呢，等一下。
items.py: nǐ jiǎn chá guo xíng li le ma hái méi jiǎn chá ne děng yī xià
items.en: Have you checked the luggage yet? Not yet, wait a moment.
items.why: 检查过…了吗 asks whether it is already done, and the answer is 还没检查呢, dropping 过 and 了. 着 means in progress, and 还没过 and 不 are not how "not yet" is said.

items.q: 咖啡我已经喝___了，不用再给我了。
items.zh: 咖啡我已经喝过了，不用再给我了。
items.py: kā fēi wǒ yǐ jīng hē guo le bù yòng zài gěi wǒ le
items.en: I've already had coffee; no need to give me more.
items.why: 已经 + V过了 means the routine thing is already done, which is why more is not needed. 着 would mean I am drinking it now.

items.q: 你有___有去过长城？
items.zh: 你有没有去过长城？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu qù guo cháng chéng
items.en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?
items.why: 有没有 is the A-not-A form of 有 and its negative is 没. 有不有 is never said, and 吗 cannot sit in the middle.

items.q: 你吃过饺子___？我可以教你包。
items.zh: 你吃过饺子没有？我可以教你包。
items.py: nǐ chī guo jiǎo zi méi yǒu wǒ kě yǐ jiāo nǐ bāo
items.en: Have you ever had dumplings? I can teach you to make them.
items.why: A question on 过 can end with 没有: 吃过…没有. 不 cannot negate 过, and 吗 is not added to 没有.

items.q: 你去过哈尔滨吗？___，去年冬天去过两次。
items.zh: 你去过哈尔滨吗？去过，去年冬天去过两次。
items.py: nǐ qù guo hā ěr bīn ma qù guo qù nián dōng tiān qù guo liǎng cì
items.en: Have you ever been to Harbin? Yes, I went twice last winter.
items.why: A yes answer repeats the verb with 过. 去了 would report one trip, and 去的 and 去着 are not answers.

items.q: 你们去过那个海边___？没去过的话，周末一起去吧。
items.zh: 你们去过那个海边吗？没去过的话，周末一起去吧。
items.py: nǐ men qù guo nà ge hǎi biān ma méi qù guo de huà zhōu mò yī qǐ qù ba
items.en: Have you been to that seaside? If not, let us go together this weekend.
items.why: A plain yes/no question on 过 takes 吗 at the end. 不 is not the question form, and 没有 and 吗 are never stacked.

items.q: 你以前去___去过那个湖？听说秋天特别美。
items.zh: 你以前去没去过那个湖？听说秋天特别美。
items.py: nǐ yǐ qián qù méi qù guo nà ge hú tīng shuō qiū tiān tè bié měi
items.en: Have you been to that lake before? I hear it's especially beautiful in autumn.
items.why: The A-not-A form of a 过 question uses 没: 去没去过. 去不去过 is wrong because 过 is never negated with 不.

items.q: 你听过这首歌吗？___，这是我第一次听。
items.zh: 你听过这首歌吗？没听过，这是我第一次听。
items.py: nǐ tīng guo zhè shǒu gē ma méi tīng guo zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì tīng
items.en: Have you heard this song? No, this is my first time.
items.why: The negative answer is 没 + verb + 过. 听了 says I did listen, 不听过 uses 不 with 过, and 听着 means listening now.

items.q: 我从来___去过那里，不知道天气怎么样。
items.zh: 我从来没去过那里，不知道天气怎么样。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo nà lǐ bù zhī dào tiān qì zěn me yàng
items.en: I've never been there, so I don't know what the weather is like.
items.why: 从来 + 没 + verb + 过 means "never once". 不 cannot go with 过, 别 is a command, and 未 is literary.

items.q: 他从来没迟到___，今天真奇怪。
items.zh: 他从来没迟到过，今天真奇怪。
items.py: tā cóng lái méi chí dào guo jīn tiān zhēn qí guài
items.en: He has never been late; today is strange.
items.why: 从来没…过 keeps 过 and takes no 了. 了 after 没 is impossible, and 着 would change the meaning to a state in progress.

items.q: 我从来没见___这么冷的天气。
items.zh: 我从来没见过这么冷的天气。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me lěng de tiān qì
items.en: I have never seen weather this cold.
items.why: 从来没见过这么… is the fixed frame for "never seen such a …". 了 cannot follow 没, and 着 does not belong here.

items.q: 我从来___喝咖啡，晚上会睡不着。
items.zh: 我从来不喝咖啡，晚上会睡不着。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē kā fēi wǎn shang huì shuì bù zháo
items.en: I never drink coffee; I wouldn't be able to sleep at night.
items.why: A habit with no 过 in the sentence takes 从来不. 从来没 and 从来没有 would need 过 after the verb.

items.q: 我们认识十年了，他从来___对我发过脾气。
items.zh: 我们认识十年了，他从来没对我发过脾气。
items.py: wǒ men rèn shi shí nián le tā cóng lái méi duì wǒ fā guo pí qi
items.en: We have known each other ten years and he has never lost his temper with me.
items.why: 发过 already carries 过, so the negative is 没: 从来没…发过. 从来不…过 is impossible, and 从来 goes before 没.

items.q: 虽然天气一直很冷，可是他___没感冒过。
items.zh: 虽然天气一直很冷，可是他从来没感冒过。
items.py: suī rán tiān qì yī zhí hěn lěng kě shì tā cóng lái méi gǎn mào guo
items.en: Even though it has been cold all along, he has never caught a cold.
items.why: "Never once" is 从来 + 没 + verb + 过. 总是 and 经常 mean always and often, and 马上 means right away; none of them pairs with 没…过 this way.

items.zh: 她以前结过婚。
items.py: tā yǐ qián jié guo hūn
items.en: She has been married before.
items.why: 结婚 is verb + object, so 过 goes between: 结过婚. 以前 may stand before or after 她, but 过 cannot move to the end.

items.zh: 我去那家店吃过饭。
items.py: wǒ qù nà jiā diàn chī guo fàn
items.en: I've eaten at that restaurant.
items.why: When 去 + place comes before another verb, 过 goes on the action verb 吃, inside 吃饭. 过 does not move onto 去.

items.zh: 我还没爬过那座山。
items.py: wǒ hái méi pá guo nà zuò shān
items.en: I haven't climbed that mountain yet.
items.why: 还 comes before 没, and 没 comes before the verb + 过. 过 cannot be dropped and 了 cannot be added.

items.zh: 我们还没一起滑过雪。
items.py: wǒ men hái méi yī qǐ huá guo xuě
items.en: We haven't skied together yet.
items.why: 还没 precedes 一起 and the verb; 过 stays on 滑 and the object 雪 follows. 没 cannot be moved after the verb.

items.zh: 我去过两次厦门。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì xià mén
items.en: I've been to Xiamen twice.
items.why: 过 comes straight after the verb. With a place name the count may come before or after it, but never before 过.

items.zh: 你骑过马没有？
items.py: nǐ qí guo mǎ méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever ridden a horse?
items.why: Ask the experience question by adding 没有 at the end. 过 stays after 骑, and 不 cannot be used.

items.zh: 你有没有在雪地里玩过？
items.py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zài xuě dì lǐ wán guo
items.en: Have you ever played in the snow?
items.why: 有没有 goes before the verb phrase and 过 stays on the verb. 吗 is not added to a 有没有 question.

items.zh: 你去过几次那个地方？
items.py: nǐ qù guo jǐ cì nà ge dì fang
items.en: How many times have you been to that place?
items.why: 几次 asks how many times and follows 过; with a place object it may come before or after the place. It cannot go before 过.

items.zh: 我从来没见过这么冷的冬天。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me lěng de dōng tiān
items.en: I have never seen such a cold winter.
items.why: 从来 comes before 没, then the verb with 过. The object 这么冷的冬天 may be fronted as a topic, but 从来 never follows 没.

items.zh: 他从来不喝冰水。
items.py: tā cóng lái bù hē bīng shuǐ
items.en: He never drinks iced water.
items.why: A habit takes 从来不 + verb with no 过. 从来 stands before 不.

items.zh: 我已经吃过饭了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo fàn le
items.en: I have already eaten.
items.why: 已经 comes before the verb; 过 goes after it and 了 closes the sentence to say the routine thing is already done.

items.zh: 他去了青岛，下星期才回来。
items.py: tā qù le qīng dǎo xià xīng qī cái huí lái
items.en: He has gone to Qingdao and won't be back until next week.
items.why: He is still away, so the trip is a completed event with a result that holds: 去了, not 去过. 才 comes right before 回来.

items.src_py: wǒ qù guo běi hǎi dào
items.task: Make it negative: you have never been.
items.zh: 我没去过北海道。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo běi hǎi dào
items.en: I have never been to Hokkaido.
items.why: The negative of 过 is 没 before the verb, and 过 stays. 不 and 了 are not possible.

items.task: Say she has not done it yet.
items.zh: 她还没学过滑冰。
items.py: tā hái méi xué guo huá bīng
items.en: She hasn't taken skating lessons yet.
items.why: "Not yet" is 还没 + verb + 过. 还 stands before 没 and 过 is kept.

items.task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
items.zh: 你见过大雪吗？
items.py: nǐ jiàn guo dà xuě ma
items.en: Have you ever seen heavy snow?
items.why: A yes/no question on 过 just adds 吗 at the end. 过 stays and the verb is not negated.

items.src_py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng
items.task: Ask with 没有 at the end.
items.zh: 你看过这个电影没有？
items.py: nǐ kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever seen this film?
items.why: The 没有 question keeps 过 after the verb and puts 没有 at the end. 不 cannot form this question.

items.task: Say you have been twice, with the number after 过.
items.zh: 我去过两次西安。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì xī ān
items.en: I've been to Xi'an twice.
items.why: 过 follows the verb and the count follows 过. A place name may come before or after the count.

items.src_py: tā kàn guo zhè běn shū
items.task: Say he has read it twice all the way through, object first.
items.zh: 这本书他看过两遍。
items.py: zhè běn shū tā kàn guo liǎng biàn
items.en: He has read this book twice through.
items.why: 遍 counts a full run-through of a book. The object is fronted as a topic and 两遍 follows 看过.

items.task: Say it was already done: add 已经 and 过, object first.
items.zh: 药他已经吃过了。
items.py: yào tā yǐ jīng chī guo le
items.en: He has already taken his medicine.
items.why: V过了 reports a routine thing as already done. 已经 goes before the verb and 了 closes the sentence.

items.src_py: wǒ jiàn guo zhè me dà de yǔ
items.task: Say you have never seen it.
items.zh: 我从来没见过这么大的雨。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me dà de yǔ
items.en: I have never seen rain this heavy.
items.why: 从来没…过 means "never once" and keeps 过. 从来 stands before 没, and 不 or 了 cannot replace it.

items.src_py: tā mǎi guo yī bǎ xīn sǎn
items.task: Say he bought it yesterday, as one specific event.
items.zh: 他昨天买了一把新伞。
items.py: tā zuó tiān mǎi le yī bǎ xīn sǎn
items.en: He bought a new umbrella yesterday.
items.why: A named day and a counted object make one specific event, so 了 replaces 过.

items.s_py: wǒ bù qù guo qīng dǎo
items.zh: 我没去过青岛。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo qīng dǎo
items.en: I have never been to Qingdao.
items.why: 过 never takes 不; the negative of an experience is 没 + verb + 过.

items.s_py: wǒ men zài xuě tiān jiàn miàn guo
items.zh: 我们在雪天见过面。
items.py: wǒ men zài xuě tiān jiàn guo miàn
items.en: We have met on a snowy day.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes between: 见过面. 过 cannot come after the whole word.

items.s_py: wǒ qù sān cì guo chéng dū
items.zh: 我去过三次成都。
items.py: wǒ qù guo sān cì chéng dū
items.en: I've been to Chengdu three times.
items.why: 过 follows the verb at once, and the count comes after it. The count cannot stand between 去 and 过.

items.s_py: wǒ jiàn guo liǎng cì tā
items.zh: 我见过她两次。
items.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
items.en: I have met her twice.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count. Only an ordinary noun or place name can follow it.

items.s_py: nǐ chī bù chī guo huǒ guō
items.zh: 你吃没吃过火锅？
items.py: nǐ chī méi chī guo huǒ guō
items.en: Have you ever had hotpot?
items.why: The negative of 过 is 没, so the A-not-A form is 吃没吃过. 不 never goes with 过.

items.s_py: nǐ kàn guo méi yǒu zhè běn shū
items.zh: 你看过这本书没有？
items.py: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū méi yǒu
items.en: Have you read this book?
items.why: 没有 closes the question, after the object: 看过这本书没有. It cannot sit between 过 and the object.

items.s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē guo bīng shuǐ
items.zh: 我从来没喝过冰水。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi hē guo bīng shuǐ
items.en: I've never drunk iced water.
items.why: With 过 the negative must be 没. 从来不 exists only without 过, for a habit.

items.s_py: yào wǒ hái méi chī guo le
items.zh: 药我还没吃呢。
items.py: yào wǒ hái méi chī ne
items.en: I haven't taken the medicine yet.
items.why: 吃过了 means already done; its negative is plain 还没吃 (呢). 了 cannot follow 没 and 过 is not needed.

items.s: 他去过广州，下个月才回来。
items.s_py: tā qù guo guǎng zhōu xià ge yuè cái huí lái
items.zh: 他去了广州，下个月才回来。
items.py: tā qù le guǎng zhōu xià ge yuè cái huí lái
items.en: He has gone to Guangzhou and won't be back until next month.
items.why: He is still away, so the trip is a completed event with a result that holds: 了. 过 would say the trip is over and he is back.

items.s_py: wǒ méi qù guo hǎi biān le
items.zh: 我没去过海边。
items.py: wǒ méi qù guo hǎi biān
items.en: I have never been to the seaside.
items.why: 没 + verb + 过 already says "never"; 了 cannot be added after it.

items.s: 我在冬天的北方待过两个星期。
items.s_py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de běi fāng dāi guo liǎng ge xīng qī
items.zh: 我在冬天的北方待过两个星期。
items.py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de běi fāng dāi guo liǎng ge xīng qī
items.en: I spent two weeks in the north in winter.
items.why: 过 can go with a stated duration; it still marks a stay that is over and now counts as experience.

items.s: 我小时候在河上滑过冰。
items.s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou zài hé shàng huá guo bīng
items.zh: 我小时候在河上滑过冰。
items.py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou zài hé shàng huá guo bīng
items.en: I skated on the river as a child.
items.why: 滑冰 is verb + object so 过 sits inside it, and 小时候 marks an experience that is over.

items.s: 朋友生了病，所以今天的聚会她来不了。
items.s_py: péng you shēng le bìng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān de jù huì tā lái bù liǎo
items.zh: 朋友生了病，所以今天的聚会她来不了。
items.py: péng you shēng le bìng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān de jù huì tā lái bù liǎo
items.en: My friend is ill, so she can't come to today's gathering.
items.why: The illness is a specific event whose result still holds today: 了. 过 would only say she has been ill at some time and would not explain her absence.

items.s: 这个故事我听过很多遍，可是还想再听。
items.s_py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn kě shì hái xiǎng zài tīng
items.zh: 这个故事我听过很多遍，可是还想再听。
items.py: zhè ge gù shi wǒ tīng guo hěn duō biàn kě shì hái xiǎng zài tīng
items.en: I've heard this story many times, but I still want to hear it again.
items.why: The object is fronted and 遍 follows 听过, the normal frame for repeated run-throughs. 过 stays on the verb.

items.s_py: nǐ xué guo yóu yǒng méi yǒu
items.zh: 你学过游泳没有？
items.py: nǐ xué guo yóu yǒng méi yǒu
items.en: Have you ever learned to swim?
items.why: 过 sits inside 游泳 and 没有 closes an experience question. This is the normal 没有 form.

items.s: 他从来不吃辣，所以从来没吃过火锅。
items.s_py: tā cóng lái bù chī là suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi chī guo huǒ guō
items.zh: 他从来不吃辣，所以从来没吃过火锅。
items.py: tā cóng lái bù chī là suǒ yǐ cóng lái méi chī guo huǒ guō
items.en: He never eats spicy food, so he has never had hotpot.
items.why: The habit is 从来不吃, with no 过; the experience is 从来没吃过, with 过. Each negative matches its meaning.

items.s: 我在冬天的海边散过步。
items.s_py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de hǎi biān sàn guo bù
items.zh: 我在冬天的海边散过步。
items.py: wǒ zài dōng tiān de hǎi biān sàn guo bù
items.en: I have taken walks by the sea in winter.
items.why: 散步 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it: 散过步. The place phrase stays before the verb.

items.s: 我去年夏天去过一次大连。
items.s_py: wǒ qù nián xià tiān qù guo yī cì dà lián
items.zh: 我去年夏天去过一次大连。
items.py: wǒ qù nián xià tiān qù guo yī cì dà lián
items.en: I went to Dalian once last summer.
items.why: A past time word does not rule out 过: the speaker cites a trip as experience and counts it with 一次.

items.s_py: tā cóng lái méi yǒu piàn guo wǒ
items.zh: 他从来没有骗过我。
items.py: tā cóng lái méi yǒu piàn guo wǒ
items.en: He has never lied to me.
items.why: 从来 + 没有 + verb + 过 is the normal "never once"; 没有 may replace 没 and 过 stays.
